blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language models acquire their capabilities from training data, and developers withhold data during training to keep models from learning capabilities that could be misused. How long this delays a capability, and how much data is needed to acquire it later, is unknown. Here we show that the general progress a model makes on the rest of its training data substitutes for the data that was withheld. We withheld the training signal for individual skills in models of chess, Othello, molecular strings, bracket languages and web text. The delay of a withheld skill in larger models was predicted from smaller ones. A chess model never explicitly trained to respond to check ranked the legal responses almost as well as a model that was. When models were then trained on the withheld data, they acquired the skill with a small fraction of the data needed from initialization, and this fraction decreased as the models progressed. A control rule of equal difficulty was learned much more slowly. A programming language withheld from the training text of a 7-billion-parameter model was regained in the same way. Data filtering therefore delays a capability, and the data required to regain it decreases as models improve.
blocks.zh: 语言模型从培训数据中获得其能力,开发者在培训期间保留数据,使模型无法学习可能被滥用的能力. 尚不清楚这种能力延迟了多久,以及以后需要多少数据才能获得。 我们在此表明,一个模型在其余培训数据方面的总体进展取代了被扣下的数据。 我们扣下了国际象棋、奥赛罗、分子弦、括号语言和网络文字模型的个人技能训练信号。 据预测,较小型的模型将延迟使用未掌握的技能。 一个国际象棋模式从来没有经过明确的训练来应对检查,几乎对法律反应以及一个模式进行了排名。 当模型随后接受关于被扣数据的培训时,他们以初始化后需要的一小部分数据获得技能,随着模型的进步,这一分数也随之下降. 对同等困难的控制规则的了解要慢得多。 70亿参数模型的培训文本中不包含的一种编程语言也以同样的方式重新获得。 因此,数据过滤延误了能力,而重新获得能力所需的数据随着模型的改进而减少。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Developers shape the capabilities of language models through their training data. Mixtures are tuned to balance domains ( Ye et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2023 ) , and documents or individual targets are removed to withhold a capability that could be misused ( O’Brien et al., 2026 ; Rathi and Radford, 2026 ; Maini et al., 2025 ) . The effect of such a filter depends on how long it holds the capability back as the model improves and on how much data the model needs to acquire the capability once the data return. Scaling laws relate compute, data and model size to loss ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ; Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) , and loss indexes when skills appear ( Du et al., 2024 ; Xia et al., 2023 ) . Neither gives how much of a skill comes from its own examples and how much from the rest of the training data.
blocks.zh: 开发者通过他们的训练数据来塑造语言模型的能力. 混合物的调整是为了平衡域(Ye等人,2025年;Liu等人,2025年;Xie等人,2023年),并删除文件或个人目标,以扣压可能被滥用的能力(O ' Brien等人,2026年;Rathi和Radford,2026年;Maini等人,2025年)。 这种滤波器的效果取决于它随着模型的改进而使能力倒退了多久,取决于模型在数据返回后需要多少数据才能获得这种能力. 扩展法将计算、数据和模型大小与损失相联系(Kaplan等人,2020年;Hoffmann等人,2022年),以及技能出现时的损失指数(Du等人,2024年;Xia等人,2023年)。 也没有给出多少技能来自其自身的例子,多少来自其余的培训数据。

blocks.en: Earlier results show that the rest of the corpus contributes to a skill. Pretraining reduces the data a later task needs ( Hernandez et al., 2021 ; Tripuraneni et al., 2020 ) , capabilities suppressed by pruning or unlearning are regained with little further training ( Lo et al., 2024 ; Deeb and Roger, 2024 ) , and progress accumulates before a score moves ( Barak et al., 2022 ; Nanda et al., 2023a ) . The closest study is that of Rathi and Radford ( Rathi and Radford, 2026 ) , who filtered a medical domain from models of 61M to 1.8B parameters. They found that filtering becomes more effective with scale and that adversarial fine-tuning restores the unfiltered baseline with less than 0.2% of the pretraining tokens, a share that falls with model size. These studies do not give the size of the delay, how the cost of acquiring a withheld capability depends on the model’s progress, or a control for whether the saving is specific to the withheld skill.
blocks.zh: 早期的结果显示,其他的教程有助于技能. Pretraining减少后期任务需要的数据(Hernandez等人,2021年;Tripuraneni等人,2020年),在几乎没有进一步培训的情况下,恢复了因钻探或未学习而抑制的能力(Lo等人,2024年;Deeb和Roger,2024年),在分数移动之前,进展积累(Barak等人,2022年;Nanda等人,2023年a年)。 最近的研究是拉特希和拉德福德(Rathi and Radford, 2026)的研究,后者将一个医疗领域从模型的61M到1.8B参数进行过滤. 他们发现,滤波随着规模的扩大而变得更加有效,对抗性的微调以不足0.2%的预训令牌恢复未过滤的基线,这一份额随模型大小而下降. 这些研究没有说明延误的程度,获得被扣能力的费用如何取决于模型的进展,或是否控制这种节省是否与被扣技能有关。

blocks.en: Here we show that withholding a capability’s training data delays the capability by a predictable amount, that progress on the rest of the corpus substitutes for the withheld data, and that acquiring the capability once its data return becomes cheaper as models improve. We use target thinning, which removes a fixed fraction of a skill’s next-token targets from the training loss while every input token stays in the text, and then return the targets. Models are compared at matched background loss, the prediction error on held-out text outside the thinned targets. The experiments cover chess and Othello ( Toshniwal et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Nanda et al., 2023b ; Karvonen, 2024 ; McGrath et al., 2022 ) , molecular SMILES strings ( Weininger, 1988 ; Schwaller et al., 2019 ; Varadi et al., 2025 ) , Dyck languages ( Hewitt et al., 2020 ; Wen et al., 2023 ) and web text, in models of up to 7 billion parameters.
blocks.zh: 在这里,我们显示,不提供能力的培训数据会延误能力,造成数量可以预测的延误,其他替代所缺数据的项目取得进展,一旦数据返回随着模型的改进而更加便宜,就获得能力。 我们使用目标稀释,它从训练损失中去掉了技能的下个目标中的一部分,而每个输入符留在文字中,然后返回目标。 模型在相应背景损失时比较,即稀疏目标以外的搁置文本的预测错误。 实验涵盖国际象棋和奥赛罗(Toshniwal等人,2022年;Li等人,2023年;Nanda等人,2023年b;Karvonen,2024年;McGrath等人,2022年),分子 SMILES字符串(Weininger,1988年;Schwaller等人,2019年;Varadi等人,2025年),Dyck语言(Hewitt等人,2020年;Wen等人,2023年)和网络文本,以70亿参数为模型.

blocks.en: For king safety in chess, and for the capitals of countries in a 7-billion-parameter web-text model, the delay follows, with no fitted parameter, from a model that keeps all of the skill’s targets and one that keeps none; for the other skills the same form holds with fitted parameters. A model that never received the targets has learned much of the skill, and when the targets return it acquires the skill with a small fraction of the data needed from initialization. This cost falls as the model progresses: for each logit by which a supervised model at the same progress exceeds the acquisition level, about tenfold in chess and web text and fourfold in SMILES. These relations predict both trends reported by Rathi and Radford. The deficit that a filter leaves widens with progress, and the same progress makes the capability cheaper to acquire once its data return.
blocks.zh: 为了国王在围棋中的安全,以及各国首都在70亿参数的网络文本模型中,没有安装参数的延迟来自一个保持所有技能目标的模式,一个没有设定目标的模型;其他同样形式的技能有配置参数。 一个从未获得过目标的模型已经掌握了很多技能,当目标返回时,它用初始化所需的一小部分数据获得技能. 这一成本随着模型的进步而下降:对于一个同一进度的受监督模型超过获取水平的每个登录器,国际象棋和网络文本大约是10倍,而SMILES则是4倍。 这些关系都预测了拉齐和拉德福德所报告的两种趋势. 过滤器留下的不足随着进展而扩大,同样的进展使得一旦数据返回,获得的能力更便宜。

blocks.en: 2 Results
blocks.zh: 2 结果

blocks.en: 2.1 Delay from thinning a skill’s targets
blocks.zh: 2.1 缩短技能目标造成的延误

blocks.en: We asked by how much a skill is delayed when only a fraction of its examples is supervised. We trained decoder-only transformers whose hyperparameters transfer across scales ( Dey et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2021 ) and kept a fraction f f of the next-token targets selected by a skill-specific rule, the retained fraction, while every input token stayed in the sequence (Fig. 1a). In chess the rule is king safety, which applies when the side to move is in check, on about 7% of boards. King-safety competence q q is the probability that the model assigns to legal escapes from check, relative to legal plus king-unsafe moves. Background loss L L is the held-out prediction error on all positions outside the thinned targets. Comparing models at the same L L separates the effect of a skill’s own targets from progress on the rest of the corpus (Fig. B1).
blocks.zh: 我们问道,当只监督一小部分技能的例子时,技能被拖延了多少时间。 我们训练了只有解码器的变压器,其超参数的变压器跨尺度传输(Dey等人,2025年;Yang等人,2021年),并且保留了按照技能特定规则选择的下一个切入目标中的一部分ff,即保留分数,而每个输入符号都留在序列中(图1a). 在围棋中,规则是王安全,当移动的一方处于控制状态时,该规则适用于约7%的棋盘上. King-security conference q q是该模型相对于法律加King-unsecurity的动作,为合法逃避检查分配的概率. 背景损失LL是稀薄目标外所有位置的搁置预测错误. 同一LL的模型比较,将技能本身目标的效果与本书其他部分的进展区分开来(图B1)。

blocks.en: We measured the delay as a shift of onset, the background loss at which competence reaches a fixed level. In 9.7M-parameter chess models, keeping 10% of in-check targets moved onset at a competence of 0.70 by 0.40 nats towards lower background loss (Fig. 1e). Removing an equal density of random targets left onset unchanged, and giving every in-check target a loss weight of 0.1 produced the same competence as keeping 10% at full weight (Fig. B2h,i).
blocks.zh: 我们测算的是延迟的发生时间,即能力达到固定水平的背景损失。 在9.7M参数的围棋模型中,将10%的检查中目标以0.70的容量移动到0.40纳特转向较低的背景损失(图1e)。 消除随机目标相同密度的未改变触发状态,使每个被检查目标损失0.1的重量产生与保持10%的完全重量相同的能力(图B2h,i)。

blocks.en: We tested the relation on thinned chess models. With the shift applied to every position of the fully supervised model and corpus support read from the never-supervised model, it gave the offsets of 15 thinned 9.7M models with a root-mean-square error of 0.039 logits, and those of 64M models at retained fractions down to 0.01 with an error of 0.089 logits (Fig. 1c). Competence q q pools the probability mass of all test positions, and pooling scales the response by a sensitivity of 0.55–0.67. With this sensitivity, the pooled form describes 4,312 offsets from 109 chess trajectories at retained fractions from 0 to 0.7 with a residual standard deviation of 0.034 logits (Fig. B2k). The relation also gave the offsets of 7-billion-parameter web-text models that kept 30% of the targets stating a country’s capital. In each of two seeds, the offsets derived from a fully supervised and a never-supervised model of that seed differed from the measured ones by 0.14 logits (root mean square) at 16 background losses, less than half the 0.31 logits by which the measured offsets of the two seeds differed; the retained fraction alone missed them by 0.61 logits (Fig. 1c and Fig. B2n). Othello, SMILES, Dyck languages and web text show the delay (Fig. B4) and follow the pooled form with their own fitted sensitivities (Fig. 1d). With no fitted parameter, the relation missed the offsets of five skills of 9.7M models in these domains by 0.26–0.80 logits and those of a Dyck skill by 1.7 logits; fitted at each background loss, it described all six with errors of 0.10–0.42 logits.
blocks.zh: 我们用薄薄的棋子模型测试了关系. 由于完全监督的模型和实体支持的每一个位置都适用了从从未监督的模型中读取的转变,它给出了15个稀疏的9.7M模型的抵消,其中根-正方位误差为0.039对数,64M模型中保留分数的抵消为0.01,误差为0.089对数(图1c)。 能力 q Q 集合所有测试位置的概率质量,集合反应的灵敏度为0.55-0.67。 有了这种敏感性,集合表描述从109个围棋轨距中以0至0.7的留成分数抵消4,312个,剩余标准偏差为0.034对数(图B2k). 关系还抵消了70亿参数的网络文本模型,这些模型保留了30%的目标,说明一个国家的资本。 在两个种子中每个种子中,完全监督的和从未监督的种子模型产生的抵消值与测量的种子的抵消值相差0.14对数(根平均平方),在16个背景损失中,低于测量的两种子抵消值的0.31对数的一半;仅留存的种子就少了0.61对数(图1c和图B2n)。 Othello、SMILES、Dyck语言和网络文本显示延迟(图B4),并用它们自己适应的敏感性(图1d)跟踪集合形式。 由于没有安装参数,关系中忽略了上述领域9 7M型的5种技能的抵消:0.26-0.80对数;Dyck型技能的抵消:1.7对数;在每一次背景损失中,它都描述了所有6种,误差为0.10-0.42对数。

blocks.en: Corpus support falls as a model improves, from 0.15–0.16 at 2.8 nats of background loss to 0.014–0.015 at 1.85 nats, and it shows no trend with model size. The deficit of a model that lacks a share of the targets therefore widens with progress. Between 2.6 and 1.8 nats the offset grew by 0.22 logits for models that kept 30% of the targets and by 1.39 logits for models that kept none (Fig. B2l,m).
blocks.zh: 公司支持随着模型的改进而下降,从背景损失的0.15-0.16分2.8纳特降至1.85纳特的0.014-0.015分,模型尺寸没有趋势。 因此,缺乏目标份额的模式的不足随着进展而扩大。 在2.6至1.8纳特之间,对保持30%目标的模型的抵消增加了0.22个对数,对保持无的模型(图B2l,m)增加了1.39个对数。

blocks.en: The delay in background loss changed little with model size. From 9.7M to 3.0B parameters under a matched schedule, keeping 10% of in-check targets delayed onset by 0.29–0.49 nats at competence levels q ≥ 0.70 q\geq 0.70 , and the delay changed by 0.00–0.03 nats for each tenfold increase in size (Fig. 1e and Fig. B3). Filtering whole documents had a similar effect. Removing chess games that contain a check produced 78–87% of the delay obtained by thinning in-check targets to the share that the filter left (Fig. 1f).
blocks.zh: 背景损失的延迟随着模型大小变化不大. 在相应的时间表下,从9.7M到3.0B参数,在能力水平上将10%的检查目标延迟启动0.29-0.49纳特 q 0.70 q\ geq 0.70,每增加10倍的面积(图1e和图B3)。 过滤整个文档的效果类似 。 删除包含检查内容的棋盘游戏产生了78–87%的延迟,这些延迟是通过将检查中的目标变薄到过滤器留下的份额(图1f).

blocks.en: Because the response to thinning is stable across sizes, we calibrated it on small models and applied it to larger ones. Each prediction adds this response to the larger model’s own fully supervised trajectory, with no parameter fitted to the thinned model. For chess fractions, sizes and learning-rate schedules ( Hägele et al., 2024 ) omitted from calibration, median errors were 0.026–0.040 logits, and the response calibrated up to 431M parameters predicted models of 1.28B and 3.0B (Fig. 1g and Fig. B2a,b). On web text, responses calibrated at 60M–1B predicted the onset shifts of six thinned skills in 7-billion-parameter models with a mean error of 0.058 nats (Fig. 1h and Fig. B5).
blocks.zh: 由于对稀薄的反应在大小上是稳定的,我们用小模型校准,并应用到较大的模型上. 每项预测都将这一反应添加到更大的模型本身完全监督的轨迹中,没有参数与薄度模型相匹配。 对于国际象棋分数,大小和学习率表(Hägele等人,2024年)在校准中省略,中值误差为0.026–0.040对数,响应校准了高达431M的参数预测模型1.28B和3.0B(图1g和图2a,b). 在网络文本上,60M-1B的响应校准预言了70亿参数模型中6种瘦技能的发端转变,平均误差为0.058纳特(图1h和图B5)。

blocks.en: 2.2 Outputs of a never-supervised model
blocks.zh: 2.2 从未监督的模型的产出

blocks.en: The derivation attributes part of a skill to the rest of the corpus, so we examined what a model trained without a skill’s targets predicts at the skill’s positions. We assigned every output token at 8,313 held-out in-check positions to a class of move (Fig. 2a). A chess model trained without in-check targets placed about half of its probability on moves that would be legal if the king were not in check, 0.48 for the 64M model at its last snapshot against 0.02 for the fully supervised model. Where two or more replies were legal, its most probable legal reply was the move played in the game at 0.64 of positions, against 0.68 for the fully supervised model and 0.30 by chance (Fig. 2b).
blocks.zh: 因此,我们审视了没有技能目标而受训的模型对技能位置的预测。 我们把8 313个待查位置的每个输出符都分配到一个移动类别(图2a)。 接受过训练的棋子模型没有检查目标,将其概率的大约一半放在如果国王不检查的话是合法的动作上,64M模型在上一张快照中为0.48,完全监督模型为0.02. 在两个或两个以上的答复合法的情况下,其最可能的法律答复是游戏中以0.64个位置的动作,而完全监督的模型为0.68个,偶然0.30个(图2b).

blocks.en: Under target thinning, replies to check remain in the text the model reads. We therefore trained chess models on games in which no check occurs. At the first check of a held-out game, these models ranked the move played first among the legal replies in 0.65–0.68 of games at 9.7M–163M parameters, against 0.68–0.71 for fully supervised models. Their preference followed the position: in pairs of positions in which the same two quiet moves exchange legality, they preferred the legal move on both boards in 0.65 of pairs at 9.7M and 0.78 at 163M, against 0.93–0.97 for fully supervised models and zero for a ranking that ignores the board (Fig. 2e–g).
blocks.zh: 在缩小目标下,核对答复仍保留在模型的文本中。 因此,我们在没有检查的比赛中训练了国际象棋模型。 在对被搁置的游戏进行首次检查时,这些模型以9.7M–163M参数的0.65–0.68的游戏中,将所扮演的动作排在了法律答复的第一位,而完全监督的模型则以0.68–0.71的成绩排在首位. 他们倾向于采取的立场是:在两个相同静静动作交换合法性的对位中,他们倾向于两板在9.7M的0.65对对位和163M的0.78对位,而完全监督的模型为0.93-0.97,忽略董事会的排名为零(图2e-g)。

Key, two of these positions, one arrow per class; not a move here, tokens no piece on the board can play. b , Fraction of in-check positions with ≥ 2 \geq 2 legal replies whose most probable legal reply is the move played, at 64M and 9.7M (two seeds); dots, the saved states of c ; dashed, chance. c , The classes of a after all in-check targets return to snapshots of the never-supervised 64M model at 1.95 and 1.62 nats, against tokens after the return as a percentage of the tokens the 64M model needs from initialization to reach a legal-move mass of 0.6 (dashed); dots, saved states after 0–16 steps. d , SMILES, 9.7M model trained without ring-closure targets: next-token probability at 23,190 ring-closure positions by class of token (line, true closing digit), against background loss (left) and after all ring-closure targets return to the last snapshot (right; tokens as a percentage of those from initialization; dashed, 0.6; dots, saved states). e , Two held-out first checks on which the same two king moves, A and B, exchange legality (colours as in a ). f , Logit margin of A over B where A is legal against that where B is legal, for 18,701 board pairs at 64M; dashed, zero and equal margins. g , Board pairs with the legal move preferred on both boards, and first checks with the move played ranked first, by model size (95% intervals; dashed, baselines). blocks.en: When the in-check targets were returned to the training loss of the 64M model, the first million tokens, 0.9% of the tokens needed from initialization, moved a third of the probability away from moves that ignore the check, most of it to moves of the king (Fig. 2c). The ranking among the legal replies did not change (Fig. 2b). The gain over these first steps was larger at lower background loss, 0.30 against 0.23 of the probability.
blocks.zh: 当检查中的目标返回到64M型的训练损失时,第一百万令牌,初始化所需的令牌的0.9%,将概率的三分之一从忽略检查的动作移到国王的动作(图2c). 法律答复的排名没有变化(图2b)。 这些最初步骤的收益在背景损失较低时较大,为0.30,而概率为0.23。

blocks.en: Supervision on one kind of reply did not transfer to another. From the 9.7M model trained on games without a check, 3,072 supervised replies to knight checks, which cannot be blocked, raised legal-move mass at held-out knight checks from 0.57 to 0.90 and lowered it from 0.39 to 0.35 where every legal reply is a block, as did the same number of ordinary moves; supervised blocks raised it to 0.89 there (Fig. C1).
blocks.zh: 对一种答复的监督没有转移到另一种答复。 从9.7M型在没有支票的情况下接受过游戏训练的游戏中,3 072次监督对骑士检查的答复,这些答复不能被阻断,将被扣留的骑士检查中的法律移动质量从0.57提高到0.90,并将其从0.39降至0.35,每一次法律答复都是块块,普通动作的数量也一样;监督块将其提高到0.89(图C1)。

blocks.en: Molecular strings showed the same sequence from a lower starting point. Without ring-closure targets, a SMILES model wrote a further atom where a ring should close and gave the closing digit a probability of 0.0004. Two optimizer steps after the targets returned, the digit had a probability of 0.36 (Fig. 2d).
blocks.zh: 分子弦从较低的起点显示相同的序列. 没有环闭合目标,一个SMILES模型写了另一个原子,一个环应该关闭,使关闭的数位概率为0.0004. 目标返回后有两个优化步骤,数字的概率为0.36(图2d).

blocks.en: 2.3 Cost of acquiring a withheld skill
blocks.zh: 第2.3条 获得被扣技能的费用

blocks.en: We measured how much data a never-supervised model needs to acquire the skill once its targets return. We returned the targets at checkpoints along the training of a source model, a model trained without the skill’s targets, and trained until competence reached a fixed level, the acquisition level (Fig. 3a). The acquisition cost is the number of tokens this took, relative to the tokens a same-size model needs to reach the level from initialization ( Hernandez et al., 2021 ) . When the targets returned, chess source models had a king-safety competence of 0.32–0.50, below the acquisition level. From each source run’s lowest-loss checkpoint, acquisition required at most 0.10–0.78% of the tokens needed from initialization, and 3.1–7.5% when the 50 preceding steps that restore the optimizer state, which contain none of the returned targets, are also counted (Fig. D1e).
blocks.zh: 我们测量了一个从未接受过监督的模型在目标返回后需要获得多少数据。 我们沿着一个源头模型、一个没有技能目标的模型的培训返回了检查站的目标,并且一直接受培训,直到能力达到一个固定的水平,即获得的水平(图3a)。 购置成本是所花费的令牌数量,相对于一个相同大小的模型需要从初始化达到的令牌数量(Hernandez等人,2021年). 当目标返回时,国际象棋来源模型具有0.32-0.50的王安全能力,低于获取水平。 从每个源头的最低损失检查点,从初始化时需要最多0.10–0.78 %的代币购买,在恢复未包含任何返回目标的优化状态的前50个步骤(图D1e)也被计算时,需要3.1–7.5 % 。

blocks.en: To test whether this saving is specific to the withheld skill, we used a control rule that applies one fixed permutation of the move labels to every in-check target. The permuted rule matches the true escapes in entropy and attainable accuracy, but its targets are the permuted labels and not the escaping moves, and from initialization the two rules needed the same number of tokens to within a factor of 1.06. From the same source checkpoints, the permuted rule needed 2.4–16 times the tokens of the true rule (Fig. 3b). The cost changed little with batch size. For returns of 25 steps or more, a fourfold smaller batch needed 1.1–1.65 times the tokens in 4.3–6.6 times as many steps (Fig. D1j).
blocks.zh: 为了测试这种保存是否是特定于被扣留的技能,我们采用了一个控制规则,对每个检查中的目标都应用一个固定的移动标签。 穿刺规则与在 en和可实现的准确性中的真实逃逸相符,但其目标为穿刺标签而非逃逸动作,从初始化来看,两项规则需要在1.06的系数内获得同样数量的符号. 同一来源的检查站,通行规则需要2.4至16倍于实际规则的标志(图3b)。 成本随批量大小变化不大。 对于25个步或以上的返回,4倍小的批次需要4.3至6.6个步数(图D1j)中信使的1.1-1.65倍.

blocks.en: We asked what determines the cost across checkpoints, model sizes and returned shares. For a returned share s s , the acquisition loss is the background loss at which a model trained with that share from the start reaches the acquisition level. The logit distance is the log odds of the acquisition level minus the log odds of a same-size model trained with the returned share, read at the background loss at which the targets return. A negative distance, which we call a surplus, means that the source model has passed the acquisition loss. Source models that received their targets before reaching the acquisition loss acquired the skill when their own background loss reached it, with a median difference of at most 0.04 nats, and their cost was the training needed to get there (Fig. 4b and Fig. D2h).
blocks.zh: 我们问,如何确定跨越检查站、模型大小和退股的成本。 对于退回的股份s, 购置损失是背景损失,在这种损失中,从开始就使用该股份培训的模型达到购置水平。 日志距离是获取水平的日志概率减去使用返回份额训练的相同大小模型的日志概率,读于目标返回的背景损失。 负距离,我们称之为盈余,意味着源模型已经通过收购损失. 在达到收购损失前获得目标的源模型在自身背景损失达到时获得技能,其中位差最多为0.04纳特,其成本是到达所需的培训(图4b和图D2h).

blocks.en: Below the acquisition loss, each logit of surplus lowered the cost about tenfold in chess and web text and fourfold in SMILES. The cost fell by 1.12 ± 0.04 1.12\pm 0.04 decades per logit in chess, 0.91 ± 0.04 0.91\pm 0.04 in web text and 0.59 ± 0.07 0.59\pm 0.07 in SMILES, in 312 runs from 27 source runs (Fig. 4a,c and Fig. D2). The rates differed between the domains. At its acquisition loss a model needed 30%, 24% and 38% of the tokens from initialization in chess, web text and SMILES. In Othello, never-supervised models acquired the forced-pass rule within about eight optimizer steps at every distance up to 0.85 logits above the acquisition loss (Fig. D2f).
blocks.zh: 在购置损失之下,每一份剩余记录将国际象棋和网络文本的成本降低约十倍,并在SMILES中降低四倍。 费用下降了1.12 ± 0.04 1.12\pm 0.04年,每国际象棋登录数下降了0.91± 0.04 0.91\pm 0.04,在SMILES中下降了0.59± 0.07 0.59\pm 0.07,在312中从27个来源运行(图4a,c和图D2)。 各地区的比率不同。 在收购损失时,一个型号需要30%、24%和38%的国际象棋、网络文本和SMILES的初始化标志。 在Othello中,从未被监督的模型在每条距离上超过收购损失(Fig. D2f)0.85对数的约8个优化步内获得了强制通过规则.

blocks.en: Logit distance predicted the cost better than the model’s score. Among 207 runs from source models scoring near their floor, logit distance ordered 85% of the pairs within a domain by their cost, whereas the score when the targets returned ordered 53% (Fig. 4d).
blocks.zh: Logit距离预言成本比模型得分好. 在207个来自靠近地板的源模型的评分中,登录距离按成本订购了一个域内85%的对数,而目标返回时的评分则订购了53%(图4d)。

blocks.en: To test whether the effect of a return is specific to its checkpoint, we added the part of its weight change that is due to the returned targets, without training, to other checkpoints of the same chess source run. At later checkpoints of 9.7M models it raised in-check legal-move mass from 0.33–0.37 to 0.61–0.62. In 64M models a change of 1.5% of the weight norm gave 0.58–0.65 at every later checkpoint, across an 8.6-fold span of training. At earlier checkpoints it gained less, in the order of their own acquisition costs. The change made by a return of the permuted rule lost its effect on both sides of its checkpoint (Fig. F1l–o).
blocks.zh: 为了检验返回的效果是否是其检查站特有的,我们增加了由于返回目标而导致的重量变化部分,没有经过训练,该部分还加入了同一棋源运行的其他检查站. 在后来的9.7M型号检查站,它将检查后的合法移动质量从0.33-0.37提高到0.61-0.62。 在64M型号中,在经过8.6倍培训的每个后期检查站,重量标准的变化为1.5%。 在早先的检查站,根据自己的购置费用,所得较少。 恢复原有规则所带来的变化,失去了对检查站两侧的影响(图F1l-o)。

blocks.en: 2.4 Returns at 7 billion parameters
blocks.zh: 2.4 按70亿参数计算的回返

blocks.en: To test the cost relation at a larger scale, we withheld the targets that state a country’s capital in 7-billion-parameter web-text models, kept every input, and returned the targets at six checkpoints in each of two seeds. From the last three checkpoints, in order, one seed reached the acquisition level with 15%, 11% and 1.8% of the tokens needed from initialization and the other with 22%, 12% and 1.1%. From the three earlier checkpoints neither seed reached it (Fig. 3c and Fig. E1a,c). A permuted assignment of capitals to countries needed 12 times the tokens of the true one from the final checkpoint, and 1.3 times from initialization.
blocks.zh: 为了更大规模地测试成本关系,我们以70亿参数的网络文本模型扣下了一个国家首都的目标,保留了每一个输入,并在两个种子的每个种子的六个检查站归还目标。 从最后三个检查站起,一个种子达到收购水平,初始化所需的标志有15%、11%和1.8%,另一个种子达到22%、12%和1.1%。 早先的三个检查站都没有种子到达(图3c和图E1a、c)。 向各国分配首都需要最终检查站的12倍和初始化的1.3倍。

blocks.en: At the same logit distance, the 7B costs were close to those of much smaller models (Fig. 4a), at 0.28–1.45 times the values of the single line fitted to chess, web text and SMILES at 9.7M–431M (Fig. 4b,e). Across those sizes, the cost at a given logit distance fell by a further 0.28 ± 0.09 0.28\pm 0.09 decades for each tenfold increase in size (Fig. 4e).
blocks.zh: 在同一对数距离上,7B的成本接近于较小的型号(图4a),为单行棋、网络文字和SMILES装配值的0.28-1.45倍,为9.7M-431M(图4b,e)。 在这些尺寸上,在一定的对数距离上,成本又下降了0.28±0.09 0.28\pm 0.09年,每增加10倍(图4e)。

blocks.en: A whole domain returned in the same way. A 7B model trained with Rust documents filtered to 3% of their share predicted Rust terms with 52% accuracy, against 76% for the unfiltered model at matched background loss. Continued on the unfiltered corpus, it closed half of this gap with 2.1% of the tokens the unfiltered model had needed from initialization to reach the same accuracy (Fig. 3f and Fig. E1j). On 212 Rust function tasks it compiled 18% of its sampled completions at the return, against 45% for the unfiltered model, and 37% against 41% after 13% of its training tokens (Fig. 3f). Of 12 models of 20M–300M parameters trained without astronomy, Rust or Chinese documents, 11 closed half of the accuracy gap with 1.9–7.5% of the domain tokens needed from initialization, and this share showed no trend with model size (Fig. 3d,e and Fig. E2g).
blocks.zh: 整个域以同样的方式返回. 用 Rust 文件培训的7B 模型过滤到3% 的预估 Rust 术语,精确度为 52%,而未过滤模型在相应背景损失时为 76%。 在未过滤体上,它继续用未过滤模型从初始化到达到同样准确度所需的2.1%的代币(图3f和图E1j)来弥补这一缺口的一半。 在212个Rust函数任务中,它汇编了归来时的18%的抽样完成情况,未过滤模型为45%,培训标志为13%(图3f)后为37%,41%。 在未经天文学、Rust或中国文档培训的12个20M-300M参数模型中,有11个用初始化所需的1.9-7.5 %域标的精度差距缩小了一半,这一份额没有显示模型大小的趋势(图3d,e和图2g)。

blocks.en: 2.5 Removal route and earlier supervision
blocks.zh: 2.5 清除路线和早期监督

blocks.en: We compared never-supervised source models with models from which a learned skill had been removed. In chess models from 9.7M to 163M parameters and at matched background loss, these were models whose targets were withdrawn after the skill was learned and models from which the skill was unlearned by gradient ascent ( Jang et al., 2023 ) or by misdirecting its representation ( Li et al., 2024 ) . With all targets returned, never-supervised models needed 5–20 times more tokens, depending on the route, than models that had once had the skill and started from the same legal-move probability mass (Fig. 5a,b and Fig. F1a,c). With 10% of the targets returned, never-supervised models reached the acquisition level in 5 of 13 cases, and models from the other routes in 51 of 52, of which 26 were at that level when the targets returned (Fig. 5c and Fig. F1b). When training resumed without in-check targets, models unlearned by gradient ascent rose to a king-safety competence of 0.81–0.91 within 12 steps, whereas never-supervised models moved by less than 0.03 (Fig. 5d).
blocks.zh: 我们把从未接受过监督的源模型与从中去除学习技能的模型进行比较。 在9.7M到163M参数的围棋模型和相应的背景损失中,这些模型的目标在学习了技能后被撤回,这些模型通过梯度上升(Jang等人,2023年)或错误地引导其表现(Li等人,2024年)而未能从中汲取技能。 随着所有目标返回,从未受到监督的模型需要5-20倍的代号,视路线而定,比曾经拥有技能并从相同的法律移动概率质量(图5a,b和图F1a,c)开始的模型还要多。 在目标返回10%的情况下,13个案例中有5个从未接受过监督的模型达到了获取水平,52个案例中有51个其他路线的模型达到了获取水平,其中26个在目标返回时达到这一水平(图5c和图F1b)。 在没有检查目标的情况下恢复培训时,梯度上升后未学习的模型在12个步骤内上升到0.81-0.91的王室安全能力,而从未监督过的模型移动不到0.03(图5d)。

blocks.en: The size of this advantage depended on how far the removal had lowered the skill. In SMILES models with ring closure removed, never-supervised models needed 4–11 times the tokens of models that had once had the skill. In 300M web-text models, neither withdrawal nor gradient ascent brought subject–verb agreement down to the never-supervised level, and never-supervised models needed 0.8–2.7 times the tokens of the others (Fig. F1i–k). These comparisons agree with reports of faster relearning after unlearning ( Rathi and Radford, 2026 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) and of recovery under training on unrelated data ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Łucki et al., 2025 ; Siddiqui et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 这种优势的大小取决于取消在多大程度上降低了技能。 在取消环关闭的SMILES模型中,从未被监督的模型需要4~11倍于曾经有这种技能的模型的标志. 在300M网络文本模型中,退出或梯度提升都没有将主题-动词协议降为从未监管的级别,而从未监管的模型需要0.8–2.7倍于其他的符号(F1i–k). 这些比较与以下报告一致:在未学习后更快地重新学习(Rathi和Radford,2026年;Lee等人,2025年)和在不相关数据培训中恢复(Hu等人,2025年;QQucki等人,2025年;Siddiqui等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Partial supervision before the return also lowered the cost. At matched background loss, 9.7M chess models that had kept 3% of in-check targets needed one-quarter as much training after the targets returned as models that had kept none (ratio 0.25, 95% interval 0.21–0.31; Fig. 5e).
blocks.zh: 返回前的部分监督也降低了成本。 在相应的背景损失中,保留了3%的检查目标的9.7M国际象棋模型需要四分之一的培训,而目标作为没有保存的模型返回后则需要四分之一的培训(比例0.25,95%间隔0.21-0.31;图5)。

blocks.en: Related content accounted for part of the corpus support. Removing supervision on related king-safety positions, boards outside check where a move that obeys the piece-movement rules would expose the king, reduced the fitted corpus support by 63%, whereas random removals reduced it by 33% or 19%, close to the shares of positions removed (Fig. 5f).
blocks.zh: 相关内容占了诉讼文书支持的一部分。 取消对相关国王-安全职位的监督,在外部检查遵守棋盘移动规则的举动会暴露国王,将装配的套装支持减少63%,而随机清除则减少33%或19%,接近被移除职位的份额(图5f)。

blocks.en: We asked how much of the network must change to acquire the skill. With a single upper block or adapters ( Hu et al., 2021 ) of rank 4 or 16 trainable, the return needed 1.3–7.4 times the tokens of a return that trains every parameter, which keeps 59–96% of the saving, counted in decades (Fig. 5h). Removing the representation through which attacked squares drive king moves raised the cost by 2.9% (Fig. 5g). Source models assembled from the lower blocks of one checkpoint and the upper blocks of another of the same run had acquisition costs between those of the two checkpoints (Fig. 5i).
blocks.zh: 我们问网络必须改变多少才能掌握技能。 拥有一个4级或16级可列车的单一上层区块或适配器(Hu et al, 2021),返回需要1.3–7.4倍于每个参数列车的返回符,这保留了节约值的59–96%,数十年来计算(图5h). 取消攻击方块的标志,推动国王行动,使成本提高了2.9%(图5g)。 从一个检查站的下层区块和同一跑道中另一个检查站的上层区块组装的货源模型在两个检查站之间的购置费用(图5i)。

blocks.en: 3 Discussion
blocks.zh: 3 讨论情况

blocks.en: In five domains and models of up to 7 billion parameters, thinning a skill’s training targets delayed the skill by an amount that small models predicted for larger ones. For king safety in chess and for capital recall at 7 billion parameters, the delay follows with no fitted parameter from a fully supervised and a never-supervised model at the same background loss; the other skills required a fitted sensitivity. Models trained without the targets had learned part of the skill from the rest of the corpus. When the targets returned, they acquired the skill with a small fraction of the data needed from initialization, and each logit of surplus lowered this cost about tenfold in chess and web text and fourfold in SMILES.
blocks.zh: 在多达70亿个参数的五个领域和模型中,技能培训指标的缩减使技能延迟了小模型对较大模型的预测。 对于国王在国际象棋中的安全以及70亿参数的资本召回来说,拖延之后没有从完全监督的模型中安装参数,也没有在同样的背景损失中安装从未监督过的模型;其他技能需要配备敏感性。 在没有目标的情况下接受培训的模特儿从其他教科机构学到了部分技能。 当目标返回时,他们以初始化所需的一小部分数据获得技能,每一次剩余记录将国际象棋和网络文字的成本降低约十倍,在SMILES中降低四倍。

blocks.en: Both trends reported by Rathi and Radford ( Rathi and Radford, 2026 ) follow from these relations. Corpus support falls as a model progresses, so equation ( 2 ) gives a deficit that widens with progress, and larger models progress further. By the cost relation, the same progress lowers the data needed to acquire the capability once its data return. Our measurements add the size of the delay, comparisons at matched background loss and a permuted rule that tests whether the saving is specific to the withheld skill. Filtered models of 6.9 billion parameters resisted adversarial fine-tuning on 300M tokens ( O’Brien et al., 2026 ) , 0.055% of their pretraining tokens. In our 7B model, the filtered domain returned with up to 13% of the model’s training tokens.
blocks.zh: Rathi和Radford(Rathi和Radford,2026年)报告的这两种趋势都源于这种关系。 公司支持随着模型的进步而下降,因此方程式(2)使赤字随着进步而扩大,更大的模型进一步进步. 根据成本关系,同样的进展降低了一旦数据返回后获得能力所需的数据。 我们的测量结果添加了延迟的大小,在匹配的背景损失时进行比较,以及一个穿透的规则,即测试节省是否是特定于被扣留的技能. 69亿参数的过滤模型抵制对300M令牌进行对抗性微调(O'Brien等人,2026年),占其预训令牌的0.05.5%. 在我们的7B模型中,被过滤的域名以高达13%的模型训练标志返回.

blocks.en: For data filtering, the results separate the delay at a given background loss from the cost of acquiring the skill once its data are available. Chess models trained on games without a check ranked legal replies nearly as fully supervised models did, so a filter that removed every example of the skill left much of it to be learned from the remaining games. The cost of acquiring the skill once its data returned fell as the model progressed, and it depended on how the skill had been removed. Never-supervised chess models needed 5–20 times more tokens than models from which a learned skill had been removed. Document filtering and removing targets from the loss ( O’Brien et al., 2026 ; Rathi and Radford, 2026 ) therefore affect both a model’s competence and the cost of adding the skill afterwards.
blocks.zh: 关于数据过滤,结果将某一背景损失的延迟与获得该技能的成本区分开来。 在没有检查的情况下接受过游戏训练的象棋模型几乎和完全监督的模型一样排名法律答复,因此一个过滤器移除了该技能的每一个实例,留下了从剩余游戏中学习的很多. 一旦数据返回,获得该技能的成本就会随着模型的进展而下降,这取决于该技能是如何被移除的。 从未接受过监督的象棋模式需要比从这些模式中去除学习技能的模型多5到20倍。 因此,文件过滤和从损失中清除目标(O'Brien等人,2026年;Rathi和Radford,2026年)既影响到模型的能力,也影响到随后增加技能的费用。

blocks.en: For evaluation, the score on a withheld skill was a weaker guide to this cost than logit distance. Longer pretraining can lower the quality a model reaches after a fixed fine-tune ( Springer et al., 2025 ) , and extended training on a sequence of tasks can reduce a network’s ability to learn ( Dohare et al., 2024 ) . On a withheld skill, by contrast, the data needed to reach a fixed competence fell with general progress.
blocks.zh: 就评价而言,对被扣技能的评分比对登录距离的评分更弱。 较长的预训可以降低一个模型在固定微调后达到的质量(Springer等人,2025年),关于一系列任务的扩展培训可以降低一个网络的学习能力(Dahore等人,2024年)。 与此相反,在缺乏技能的情况下,达到固定能力所需的数据随着总体进展而下降。

blocks.en: The change that completed a skill was small relative to the network. With a single upper block or adapters of rank 4 or 16 trainable, king safety was acquired with 1.3–7.4 times the tokens of a return that trains every parameter, and the weight change of a return raised legal-move mass at later checkpoints of the same run. This agrees with reports that pretraining lowers the number of parameters that adaptation requires ( Aghajanyan et al., 2021 ) and that setting fewer than 0.05% of a pretrained model’s weights to zero can match full fine-tuning ( Lu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 与网络相比,完成技能的改变很小。 拥有一个4级或16级可列车的单一上层区块或适配器,王安全就以每条参数列车的回程信号的1.3至7.4倍获得,回程的重量变化提高了同一跑道后期检查站的法律移动质量. 这与预训会降低适应所需的参数数量(Aghajanyan等人,2021年)以及将预训模型重量的0.05%以下设定为零的报告一致(Lu等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: 4 Methods
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: 4.1 Domains and data
blocks.zh: 4.1 领域和数据

blocks.en: Training corpora are contiguous token streams read once in order, so the batch schedule fixes the data order. Chess: rated Lichess games from 2024 between players rated at least 1,500, one move per token. Othello: uniformly sampled legal games ( Li et al., 2023 ) with an explicit pass token. SMILES: 300M canonical molecular strings from ZINC22 ( Tingle et al., 2023 ) , modelled at the character level. Dyck-4: well-formed nested sequences over four bracket pairs. Web text: FineWeb-Edu ( Penedo et al., 2024 ) for models of up to 163M parameters and the Dolma 1.7 recipe of DataDecide ( Magnusson et al., 2025 ) for models of 20M–7B.
blocks.zh: Training corpora是连续符号流,按顺序读一次,因此批量调度会固定数据顺序. 国际象棋:从2024年开始在玩家之间评为利切斯游戏,评分至少为1500分,每枚令牌一个动作. Othello:统一抽样的法律游戏(Li等人,2023年),带有明确的传球标志. SMILES:来自ZINC22(Tingle等人,2023年)的300M canonical分子字符串,以字符级为模型. Dyck-4:四个括号对以上的成型的巢状序列. 网页文本:FineWeb-Edu(Penedo等人,2024年),用于最多163M参数的模型和Dolma 1.7 DataDecide的配方(Magnusson等人,2025年),用于20M–7B的模型.

blocks.en: 4.2 Models and training
blocks.zh: 4.2 模式和培训

blocks.en: All models are dense pre-norm decoder-only transformers, with width and depth scaled together across seven sizes from 0.76M to 163M non-embedding parameters, and chess models of 431M, 1.28B and 3.0B. CompleteP parameterization ( Dey et al., 2025 ) ( α = 1 \alpha=1 ), anchored at 2.2M parameters, transfers learning rates across sizes. The main recipe uses AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) with a peak learning rate of 0.004, weight decay 0.1 and a warm-up–stable–decay schedule indexed in tokens per parameter. The constant-rate chess models (9.7M–3.0B) use a 15M-token warm-up and batches of 64 sequences. Sequences have 2,048 tokens. FineWeb-Edu models use a constant learning rate of 0.008 after warm-up. Dolma models have the Llama architecture as implemented in HuggingFace Transformers, without CompleteP, and use weight decay 0.05, batches of 128 sequences and, after a 32-step warm-up, a constant learning rate of 2.12 × 10 − 3 2.12\times 10^{-3} at 20M–300M, 1.06 × 10 − 3 1.06\times 10^{-3} at 1B and 2.65 × 10 − 4 2.65\times 10^{-4} at 7B; the 300M and 1B models with the designs of the two 7B models (models A and B below) use the 7B rate. Seeds change the weight initialization and read the same data stream; in the Dolma models a seed also sets the data order.
blocks.zh: 所有型号均为密集的预规范解码器专用变压器,其宽度和深度均在0.76M至163M非嵌入参数的7个尺寸上下缩放,围棋型号为431M,1.28B和3.0B. 完整P参数化 (Dey等人,2025年)(α=1\alpha=1),锚定在2.2M参数上,跨尺寸转移学习率. 主食谱使用AdamW(Loshchilov和Hutter,2019年),峰值学习率为0.004,体重衰减0.1,并按每个参数的符号索引了温和-稳定-减速表. 恒速棋型号(9.7M–3.0B)采用15M-托肯热身和批次64个序列. 序列有2,048个令牌. FineWeb-Edu模型在热身后使用持续学习率为0.08. Dolma模型有HuggingFace变形器所执行的Llama架构,没有CompleteP,并使用重量衰减0.05,批量128个序列,经过32步的热身后,在20M–300M,1.06×10–3 1.06\times 10^{-3}在1B和2.65×10−2.65\times 10^{-4}在7B,300M和1B模型采用两种7B模型(A型和B型)的设计. 种子改变重量初始化,读取相同的数据流;在Dolma模型中,种子也设置了数据顺序.

blocks.en: 4.3 Competence, background loss and target thinning
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 能力、背景损失和目标缩小

blocks.en: Target thinning removes the next-token loss at a skill’s targets unless h ⁡ ( p ) < f h(p)<f , with h h a deterministic hash of the stream position p p and f f the retained fraction. Inputs are never changed, and the training loss is the mean cross-entropy over the retained targets. The thinned targets are in-check boards in chess (7.1% of tokens), forced passes in Othello (0.73%) and ring-closing digits in SMILES (5.17%). In web text, programmatic labellers mark closing brackets, number-marked auxiliaries, repeated 4-gram completions and counting sequences, and two factual relations, country capitals and city countries, are thinned by masking answer mentions within 128 tokens after their subject.
blocks.zh: 目标变薄可以消除技能目标下接的丢失,除非h ⁡(p) < f h(p) < f,其中h 表示溪流位置的确定散列p和 f f 保留分数。 投入从未改变,培训损失是相对于保留目标的平均跨度。 较薄的目标为国际象棋的中试棋板(7.1%)、奥赛罗的强制通过(0.73%)和SMILES的环闭塞数字(5.17%)。 在网络文本中,标注括号、数字标记的辅助标志、重复的4克完成和计数顺序以及两个事实关系,即国家首都和城市国家,在标语后128个符号内被蒙面回答提及而变得模糊。

blocks.en: Competence is read on a fixed held-out split. In chess, every vocabulary token at an in-check board is assigned to an exact legality class, and king-safety competence is q = legal / ( legal + king-unsafe ) q=\text{legal}/(\text{legal}+\text{king-unsafe}) probability mass. Competence is the probability of the pass token at forced-pass positions in Othello, of the true closing digit in SMILES and, for web-text agreement, of the true form relative to the true plus the other-number form of is/are , was/were and has/have . Background loss is the held-out cross-entropy, in nats, at all targets outside the thinned ones; in Othello it is taken at positions with two or more legal squares, and in the Dolma models at targets outside every labelled class. Onset is the background loss, interpolated between log-spaced checkpoints (21–36 per chess run on the warm-up–stable–decay schedule and 52–76 on the constant rate), at which competence crosses a stated level: q = 0.70 q=0.70 , 0.75 and 0.80 in chess, where q = 0.659 q=0.659 lies on the plateau of the fully supervised trajectories, 0.4 in Othello and 0.6 in SMILES. Runs that do not reach a level are censored at their final background loss. Probes are class-balanced logistic regressions on residual-stream activations, scored against an identically probed random network, and causal use is the effect of ablating a variable’s difference-of-means direction relative to random directions ( Geiger et al., 2024 ) (Fig. B1i).
blocks.zh: 能力通过固定的搁置分拆来读取。 在国际象棋中,每个在棋盘上的词汇符号都被分配到精确的合法性类,国王-安全权限为q=legal / (legal + King-unsafe) q=\text{legal}/(\text{legal}+\text{king-unsafe})概率质量. 权限是指奥赛罗强制通过位置的通过符、SMILES中真正的关闭数字的概率,以及就网络文本协议而言,真实形式相对于真实形式加上其他数字形式是/是/是/是/是。 背景损失是坚守的交叉纵横,在Nats中,在薄膜外的所有目标上;在Othello中,它位于两个或两个以上合法方块的位置上,在Dolma模型中,它位于每个标有标签的类以外的目标上。 Onset是背景损失,介于对数的检查点之间(热身-稳定-减速表上每场比赛21-36次,恒定速下52-76次),其能力跨越一个规定的级别:q=0.70 q=0.70,0.75和0.80,其中q=0.659 q=0.659位于全监督轨迹的高原上,Othello为0.4,SMILES为0.6。 未达到某一水平的运行在最终背景损失时受到审查. 探测器是在残余流激活上的类平衡物流回归,对同一探测的随机网络得分,因果使用是比随机方向(Geiger等人,2024年)(图B1i)对变量不同计量方向的分解作用.

blocks.en: 4.4 Derived thinning relation
blocks.zh: 4.4 衍生稀疏关系

For each of 4,173 held-out in-check positions, the probability mass on legal and on king-unsafe moves at every snapshot of the fully supervised and the never-supervised model was interpolated, in log, to a 0.05-nat grid of background loss. The derived offset at retained fraction f f adds ln ⁡ [ ( f + τ ) / ( 1 + τ ) ] \ln[(f+\tau)/(1+\tau)] to the log odds of every position of the fully supervised model and pools the masses as for q q ; τ \tau at each background loss is the value at which f = 0 f=0 reproduces the pooled odds of the never-supervised model. Root-mean-square differences from the measured offsets, over models and background losses, are 0.039 logits (95% interval 0.031–0.047) for 15 thinned 9.7M models of two seeds at nine retained fractions, and 0.089 logits (0.042–0.119) for 64M models at f = 0.3 f=0.3 , 0.1, 0.03 and 0.01 (Fig. 1c). With each position’s own never-supervised odds in equation ( 1 ), in place of the common τ \tau , the differences are 0.20 and 0.32 logits.

blocks.en: The same test on thinned 9.7M models of six further skills ( f = 0.01 f=0.01 –0.5; one to three seeds per skill) gives root-mean-square errors of 0.80 logits for SMILES ring closure, 0.32 for SMILES branch closing, 0.71 for the Othello forced pass, 0.32 for the Othello forced move, 1.71 for Dyck closing brackets at match distances of 2–7 and 0.26 for web-text subject–verb agreement, against 0.31, 0.20, 0.42, 0.19, 0.39 and 0.10 for the pooled form fitted at each background loss. The derived offset is too shallow by 0.24–0.50 logits in the three skills whose never-supervised model has no competence and too deep by 0.22–0.23 in two whose never-supervised model has some; for the Dyck skill, whose never-supervised model reaches a competence of 0.27–0.43, it is too shallow by 1.36. In every skill, τ \tau falls as background loss falls.

blocks.en: At 7B, three models at each of seeds 0 and 1, with one data order per seed, keep all, none and a fraction 0.3 of the capital targets: the never-supervised models follow the recipe, seed and data order of the source models of the capital returns, the fully supervised models their references, and the thinned models follow the same recipe. At each stored snapshot we scored 816 capital prompts by the probability of the correct answer among the 102 answers and interpolated the log odds of each prompt linearly in background loss to 16 losses from 3.05 to 3.80 nats, a range spanned by seven or eight snapshots of each model. The derived offset shifts the log odds of every prompt of the fully supervised model by ln ⁡ [ ( f + τ ) / ( 1 + τ ) ] \ln[(f+\tau)/(1+\tau)] , with τ \tau the value at which f = 0 f=0 reproduces the pooled competence of the never-supervised model of the same seed, and pools. Over the 32 offsets it differs from the measured offset by 0.14 logits (root mean square; 0.13 in seed 0 and 0.14 in seed 1), deeper by 0.10 logits on average in seed 0 and shallower by 0.09 in seed 1. The retained fraction alone ( τ = 0 \tau=0 ) misses by 0.61 logits (0.69 and 0.52) and the offset of the never-supervised model by 0.43; with the never-supervised model of the other seed the error is 0.17 logits. Over the four lowest losses the error is 0.12 logits in seed 0 and 0.25 in seed 1, where the measured offset is deeper than the derived one and within 0.12 logits of the retained fraction alone. The measured offsets of the two seeds differ by 0.31 logits (0.44 over the four lowest losses). On country recall, whose targets all six models keep, the thinned and the fully supervised model differ by 0.09 logits. The test covers one retained fraction (Fig. B2n).
blocks.zh: 在7B时,每种子0和1的3个模型,每个种子一个数据顺序,保留所有,零和零分0.3的基建目标:从未监督的模型遵循基建回报源模型的食谱,种子和数据顺序,完全监督的模型参考,稀疏的模型遵循相同的食谱. 在每张存储的快照中,我们通过102个答案中正确答案的概率得出了816个资本提示,并将每张快速线性背景损失的日志概率内插到3.05至3.80纳特的16个损失中,范围为每个模型的7或8个快照。 产生的偏移通过 \\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ 的完全 模型的日志 。 在32个乘数上,它与0.14个乘数(根平均平方;0.13个种子0和0.14个种子1)的乘数不同,在0个种子中,比0.10个更深,在0.09个种子中,比更浅。 一、导 言 仅保留分数(τ=0\tau=0)误差0.61个对数(0.69个和0.52个),并用0.43来抵消从未监管的模型;用其他种子的从未监管的模型,误差为0.17个对数. 在四个最低损失中,误差是0号种子的0.12对数和1号种子的0.25对数,其中测量的偏移比所得出的偏移更深,仅保留部分的0.12对数之内。 两个种子的测量抵消值为0.31对数(4个最低损失为0.44对数)。 在国家召回方面,所有六个模型都保留了目标,而瘦小和完全监督的模型则有0.09个对数。 测试涵盖一个保留分数(图B2n).

blocks.en: For 18 skills of the four domains thinned to f = 0.5 f=0.5 , 0.3, 0.1 and 0.03 at 9.7M, the horizontal shift that aligns each thinned curve with its fully supervised curve is fitted as A k ​ ( 1 − f p ) A_{k}(1-f^{p}) (Fig. B2c–g).

blocks.en: 4.5 Held-out predictions
blocks.zh: 4.5 国家 搁置预测

blocks.en: Each chess test fits the pooled form to calibration runs only and predicts the thinned trajectories of a held-out model from its seed-mean fully supervised trajectory, with no parameter refitted. The four tests hold out fractions below 0.1, model sizes, the constant-learning-rate schedule and the 1.28B and 3.0B models, for which the predicted fraction, f = 0.1 f=0.1 , is included at every calibration size. The error is the root-mean-square logit offset error of a trajectory (Fig. B2a,b).
blocks.zh: 每一次国际象棋试验都符合集合形式校准,只运行一次,并从其种子-正子完全监督的轨迹上预测一个被搁置的模型的薄轨迹,没有参数重排. 四个测试将分数控制在0.1以下,模型大小,恒定学习率表和1.28B和3.0B模型,其中预测分数f=0.1f=0.1,每个校准大小都包括在内. 错误是弹道的根- 平均值对数抵消错误(图B2a,b)。

blocks.en: On web text, two sets of 24 runs vary the fractions of the four labelled classes, and of capitals and city countries, in Latin-square designs ( f = 1 f=1 , 0.3, 0.1; two seeds), with five and two further runs at 1B. The response is calibrated at competence levels 0.3–0.7 with censored fits of the onset against ln ⁡ f \ln f and log 10 \log_{10} parameters, and only the shift in ln ⁡ f \ln f enters a prediction. At 7B, model A thins closing and counting to 0.3, agreement to 0.05 and capitals to 0.1, and model B thins city countries to 0.1. Each skill is compared with the model in which it is fully supervised, whose trajectory the prediction shifts, and the error is the mean absolute difference between predicted and observed onset shift over six skills and three seeds (Fig. 1h and Fig. B5a–c). In the isolated contrasts, only long-range closing is thinned, to 0.3, or only agreement, to 0.05, at 150M and 300M with four seeds (Fig. B5d–i).
blocks.zh: 在网络文本上,两套24跑在拉丁方图案(f=1 f=1,0.3,0.1;2个种子)中会改变四个标注等级的分数,以及首都和城市国家的分数,在1B时会进一步运行5和2个. 校对为能力水平 0. 3–0. 7 , 在7B时,模式A瘦点关闭和计数到0.3,同意0.05和首都0.1,模式B瘦点城市国家0.1. 将每种技能与完全监督其运行的模型进行比较,预测的轨迹变化,错误是预测和观测到的6种技能和3种种子的起伏变化之间的平均绝对差别(图1h和图5a-c)。 在孤立的对比中,只有长距离的收缩变薄,到0.3,或者只有协议,到0.05,在150M和300M,有四个种子(图B5d-i).

blocks.en: 4.6 Document filtering
blocks.zh: 4.6 文件过滤

blocks.en: A chess game filter with recall γ \gamma discards each game that contains a check with probability γ \gamma and replaces it from the stream, which leaves a density of in-check targets of f ⁡ ( γ ) = ( 1 − γ ) / [ 0.058 + 0.942 ​ ( 1 − γ ) ] f(\gamma)=(1-\gamma)/[0.058+0.942(1-\gamma)] . On the constant-rate recipe, 9.7M–64M models (two seeds) were trained with game filtering or target thinning at matched residual shares (0.1, 0.03 and 0) and compared on background loss over game prefixes before the first check, with delays read at a legal-move mass of 0.6 (Fig. 1f and Fig. B4g,h).
blocks.zh: 带有 recept γ\gamma 的棋局过滤器丢弃每款包含 possible γ\gamma 的检查结果的棋局,并替换出该流的棋局,它留下的检查内目标密度为 f → ( γ) = (1– γ) / [0.058 + 0.942(1-\ gamma)]. 在恒定速率食谱上,9.7M-64M型号(双种子)在匹配的剩余股份(0.1,0.03和0)上接受了游戏过滤或目标稀释的训练,并在第一次检查前比较了游戏前缀的背景损失,以0.6的法定移动质量(图1f和图B4g,h)读取的延迟.

blocks.en: In web text, reference labels for astronomy (lexicon density), Rust (Rust-exclusive syntax) and Chinese (CJK share) mark 0.53%, 0.22% and 0.15% of the stream. A hashed n n -gram linear classifier over each document’s first 512 tokens removes documents at thresholds that leave a share f f of reference-labelled tokens. Below the lowest share that a threshold alone reaches (0.1 for astronomy, 0.03 for Rust and 0.01 for Chinese), every reference-labelled document is also removed except a hashed fraction f f of them. Models of 20M–300M parameters were trained to 1.0–3.0B tokens in a 6 × 6 6\times 6 Latin square that filters all three domains in every run, with two seeds (48 runs), together with a 1B pair at f = 1 f=1 and 0.03 and a 7B pair for Rust, model B with and without the filter at f = 0.03 f=0.03 . Competence is top-1 accuracy at tokens that require the domain skill in held-out domain documents (Fig. E2).
blocks.zh: 在网页文本中,天文学(lexicon 密度), Rust(Rust-exclusional syntax)和中文(CJK share)的参考标签标记为流的0.53%,0.22%和0.15%. 每个文档的前512个令牌上的hashed n -gm线性分类器会删除显示为引用标记令牌的共享 f 的阈值的文档 。 低于一个阈值达到的最低份额(天文学为0.1, Rust为0.03,中文为0.01),除其中的散列分数ff外,每个带有参考标记的文档也被删除。 20M–300M参数的模型在6×6 6 6\times 6拉丁方形中被训练为1.0–3.0B令牌,每跑中过滤所有三个域,其中有两个种子(48跑),同时在f=1 f=1和0.03时有一个1B对,在f=0.03 f=0.03时有一个7B对Rust,模型B带有和没有过滤器. 胜任能力在符号上是最高的1精度,需要持有域文档(图E2)中的域技能.

blocks.en: 4.7 Chess games without a check
blocks.zh: 4.7 (中文(简体) ). 棋局没有支票

blocks.en: The models trained on games without a check are the game-filter models at recall 1 (seed 1; 600M tokens at 9.7M–64M parameters and 450M at 163M); a replay of their training stream with python-chess finds no in-check position. They are evaluated at the first check with a played reply in each of 2,000 held-out games (1,704 positions, 1,533 with two or more legal replies), with the prompt ending at the checking move, against the model trained without in-check targets and the fully supervised model of the same size and seed at the saved checkpoint nearest in held-out loss before the first check. A board pair consists of two of these positions in which the same piece on the same square has the same two non-capturing, non-checking moves, one resolving the check on the first board and leaving the king attacked on the second, and the other the reverse (18,701 pairs from 1,162 games; intervals resample games). With each game in at most one pair, the four models preferred the legal move on both boards in 0.57–0.72 of pairs (Table C1). For the transfer between replies, the 9.7M model was continued on 3,072 game prefixes that end at a first check, with the loss on the reply played only. Each set of replies has one run, evaluated on 326 held-out knight checks and 92 held-out positions where every legal reply is a block (Fig. C1).
blocks.zh: 在没有检查的情况下接受过游戏训练的模型是召回1(种子1;以9.7M–64M参数为600M令牌,以163M参数为450M)的游戏-过滤模型;用蟒蛇座的训练流重播后发现没有检查位置. 在第一次检查时,在2 000个被搁置的游戏中每场(1 704个位置,1 533个有2个或2个以上法律答复),对照未经检查目标而训练的模型和在第一次检查前最接近被搁置损失的保存检查站的相同大小和种子的完全监督模型,对这些模型进行评价。 一个棋盘对由两个这些位置组成,同一个方块上的同一块有相同的两个不抓取,不检查的动作,一个解决第一个棋盘上的检查,让国王在第二个棋盘上被攻击,另一个则相反(18,701对来自1,162个游戏;间隔重现游戏). 每场比赛最多一对,这四个型号都倾向于两板上0.57–0.72对(表C1)的法律动作. 对于答复之间的传输,9.7M模式在第一次检查时结束的3,072个游戏前缀上继续使用,答复上的损失只播放. 每一套答复都有一次检查,对326次被扣留的骑士检查和92次被扣留的姿势进行评估,每一份法律答复都是块块(图C1)。

blocks.en: 4.8 Output classes at the skill’s positions
blocks.zh: 4.8 (中文(简体) ). 技能岗位的输出课程

blocks.en: For 8,313 in-check positions of 2,000 held-out chess games, each of the 1,970 output tokens was assigned with python-chess to one class: legal king moves, captures of the checking piece and interpositions; moves that would be legal if the king were not in check; king moves to an attacked square; moves that expose the king to a further piece; and tokens that are not moves of the position. In the returns of Fig. 2c the model state was saved at the end of the warm-up before the return (step 0) and after steps 1–8, 10, 12 and 16 with the returned targets (2.1M tokens); over these states the share of positions whose most probable legal reply is the move played, taken as everywhere over the 7,149 positions with two or more legal replies, stayed at 0.58–0.59 for the return from 1.95 nats and at 0.62–0.64 for the return from 1.62 nats. The 23,190 SMILES ring-closure positions of Fig. 2d come from 8,000 held-out molecules.
blocks.zh: 对于8,313个被搁置的棋局中2000个棋局的棋局中,1,970个输出符被分配到一个等级: 法王移动,捕捉检查棋盘和插位; 如果国王没有被检查的话,这些动作是合法的; 国王移动到一个被攻击的方块; 使国王暴露在另一个棋盘上的动作; 和不是位置移动的标志. 在图2c的回文中,模型状态在返回前(步骤0)和返回目标后(步骤1-8、10、12和16)的温暖状态下被保存下来;在图2c的回文中,最有可能得到法律答复的职位比例是7 149个职位的移动,到处都有法律答复,从1.95纳特返回0.58-0.59,从1.62纳特返回0.62-0.64。 Fig. 2d的23,190 SMILES环闭位置来自8000个悬浮分子.

blocks.en: 4.9 Acquisition cost after targets return
blocks.zh: 4.9 (中文(简体) ). 目标回报后的购置费用

blocks.en: Chess. Returns start from source models trained without in-check targets (three seeds each at 9.7M, 24M, 64M and 431M) at background losses of 1.56–2.87 nats and train on unseen stream segments. The targets return at a share s = 1 s=1 , 0.3, 0.1 or 0.03 with 131,072 tokens per step, in one of two return conditions. With the warm-up before the return, the AdamW second moments are estimated over 20 steps without parameter updates, the learning rate is warmed up over 30 steps without in-check targets, and the targets then return at full learning rate (110 runs). Costs count the tokens after the targets return; with these 50 steps also counted, the costs from each source run’s lowest-loss checkpoint are 3.1–7.5%. With the warm-up at the return, a 20-step warm-up starts when the targets return (188 runs; Fig. D1a–d). Six returns of all targets from 9.7M and 64M checkpoints at 2.99–3.99 nats use the warm-up before the return. Competence and background loss are evaluated on 1,000 held-out games when the targets return and then at steps spaced by a factor of 1.25. The cost is the number of tokens from the return to the first evaluation at or above the acquisition level, interpolated from the evaluation before it, divided by the tokens a same-size model needs from initialization. Acquisition is read on the in-check legal-move probability mass at a level of 0.6, and king-safety competence q q is used for the thinning results; at the first crossing of q = 0.659 q=0.659 in a return, the legal-move mass has a median of 0.60.
blocks.zh: 国际象棋. 返回从未经检查目标培训的原始模型开始(9.7M、24M、64M和431M各3个种子),背景损失为1.56-2.87纳特,在看不见的溪流段进行训练。 目标以1 s=1 s=1,0.3,0.1或0.03的比例返回,每步有131,072个令牌,为两个返回条件之一. 随着返回前的热身,亚当W的第二瞬间估计超过20个步骤,没有参数更新,学习率在30多个步骤中被热身,没有检查目标,然后目标以完全学习率(110跑)返回. 成本在目标返回后计算出象征物;由于这50个步骤也计算在内,每个来源的最低损失检查站的成本为3.1-7.5%。 随着返回时的暖化,目标返回时开始20步暖化(188跑;图1a-d). 从2.99-3.99纳茨的9.7M和64M检查站返回的所有目标中有6个在返回前使用暖气。 在目标返回时,对1 000个被搁置的游戏进行能力和背景损失评价,然后按1.25的系数计算。 成本是指从收购阶段或以上恢复到首次评审的符数,从之前的评审中内插,从初始化中除以一个相同大小的模型需要的符数. 获取值在0.6级的检查中读取,王-安全权限qq用于稀释结果;在一次返回中第一次通过q=0.659q=0.659时,合法移动质量的中位数为0.60。

blocks.en: Web text. Eleven source models of 9.7M–163M parameters were trained on FineWeb-Edu for 4–64 tokens per parameter (64, 24 and 12 at 9.7M, 24M and 64M; 8 and 4 at 163M) without the targets of number-marked finite verbs. At a return the AdamW moments are estimated as in chess, 30 steps on the source model’s own targets follow, and all agreement targets then return at 64 sequences per step on unseen rows (90 runs). Competence is evaluated at auxiliaries with a noun subject in 384 held-out sequences and the acquisition level is 0.85. The denominator is the mean over runs from initialization at the same size, recipe and batch.
blocks.zh: 网易网讯. 11个9.7M–163M参数的源模型在FineWeb-Edu上接受了每参数4–64个令牌的培训(64,24和12在9.7M,24M和64M;8和4在163M),没有数字标记的限定动词的目标. AmW的瞬间在棋盘中被估计, 源模式自身目标上的30步紧随其后, 能力在384个搁置序列中以名词为主题的辅助单位进行评估,获取水平为0.85。 分母是从同样大小、食谱和批次的初始化中产生的平均值。

blocks.en: SMILES. Ring-closing targets return to the 9.7M, 24M, 64M and 163M source models, one seed each, at seven to nine checkpoints per size with background losses of 0.48–0.85 nats (21, 19, 18 and 15 runs), at a share of 1, 0.3, 0.1 or 0.03 (64M: 1, 0.3 or 0.1; 163M: 1 or 0.3) and 16 sequences per step, after 20 moment-estimation steps and with the warm-up at the return. Competence is evaluated on 8,000 held-out molecules, the acquisition level is 0.6, and budgets are 20M–100M tokens by share. The denominator is the run from initialization of the same size and seed with the same batch and warm-up (11.3M, 11.6M, 15.8M and 20.7M tokens).
blocks.zh: 尖叫声。 环形关闭目标返回9.7M,24M,64M和163M源型号,每组1个种子,每组7到9个检查站,背景损失0.48–0.85纳特(21,19,18和15跑),份额为1,0.3,0.1或0.03(64M:1,0.3或0.1;163M:1或0.3),每步16个序列,经过20个瞬间估计步骤,并随返回时的暖化. 对8 000个持有分子的能力进行评估,采购水平为0.6,预算按份额为20M-100M令牌。 分母是相同大小和种子初始化的跑步,具有相同的批量和热量(11.3M,11.6M,15.8M和20.7M令牌).

blocks.en: Othello. All forced-pass targets return to eight source runs trained with none, 10% or 30% of them (53 runs), with the warm-up at the return and 64 sequences per step. Competence is evaluated on 2,000 held-out games, the acquisition level is 0.4 and the budget is 40M tokens. The denominator is the mean over the fully supervised runs of the same size.
blocks.zh: 奥赛罗 所有强制通过目标返回到8个源头,没有经过训练,其中10%或30%(53次运行),返回时加热,每步64个序列. 能力评价为2000个被搁置的游戏,收购等级为0.4级,预算为4000兆令牌. 分母是同样规模的完全监督运行的平均值。

blocks.zh: 4.10 (中文(简体) ). 逻辑距离和成本关系

blocks.en: A source model is near the floor when its score lies in the lowest 10% of the range between the median score of never-supervised models, taken above the acquisition loss, and the acquisition level; in chess this score is q q , with the level of 0.659. Near-floor ordering is the share of pairs of runs within a domain whose order of cost is identified and agrees with the order of the predictor: 0.85 for logit distance, 0.77 for background loss and 0.53 for the score when the targets return (Fig. 4d).
blocks.zh: 来源模型接近底部时,其得分位于永无监管模型中位分,取于收购损失,收购水平之间最低的10%;在围棋中,此得分为q q ,等级为0.659. 近层订单是指在某一域内确定成本顺序并符合预测者顺序的对运行量的比例: 对数距离0.85,背景损失0.77,目标返回时得分0.53(图4d).

blocks.en: 4.11 Batch size and learning rate at the return
blocks.zh: 4.11 联合国 批量大小和返回时的学习率

blocks.en: Chess source models at 9.7M, 24M and 64M parameters received all in-check targets, with the warm-up before the return, from three checkpoints each, with batches of 16, 64 or 256 sequences at the standard learning rate and of 64 or 16 sequences at one third of it. The warm-up used the setting of the return, every setting read the same token stream in two data orders, and each cost is divided by a run from initialization at the same setting. Because the warm-up moves the background loss by an amount that depends on the setting, the logit distance is read here at the stored checkpoint. The slope of log 10 \log_{10} relative cost against logit distance, pooled over sizes, was 1.03 ± 0.07 1.03\pm 0.07 decades per logit at the standard setting (18 runs) and 0.86–1.29 at the other four. From the lowest-loss checkpoint at 9.7M, the permuted rule needed 11.0–12.7 times the tokens of the true rule at the same settings (Fig. D1i–k).
blocks.zh: 棋源型号为9.7M,24M和64M参数的棋源型号均收到所有检查中的目标,返回前的热身,从各3个检查点出发,按标准学习率分批16,64或256个序列,其中三分之一为64或16个序列. 热身使用了返回的设置,每个设置在两个数据命令中读取相同的令牌流,每个成本从同一设置的初始化中除以运行. 由于热身将背景损失移动到一个取决于设置的量上,因此在存储的检查站这里读取日志距离. log 10\log 10 的相对成本与logit 距离相比, 集成规模过大, 在标准设置( 18 运行) 上为1.03± 0.07 0.03\pm 0.07 年, 在其他 4 个 上为 0.86–1.29 年。 从9.7M最低损失的检查站来看,穿戴规则需要11.0-12.7倍于同一场合的真正规则的标志(图D1i-k)。

blocks.en: 4.12 Transplanted weight changes
blocks.zh: 4.12 移植重量变化

blocks.en: In the two 9.7M chess source runs, the targets were returned at the 619M, 290M, 193M and 97M-token checkpoints with the warm-up before the return, each return was stopped at the first evaluation at which in-check legal-move mass reached 0.6, and its weight change was saved. A control run from each checkpoint took the same number of steps on the source’s own targets, and the change due to the returned targets is the difference between the two weight changes. It was added, without training, to each of the 22 saved checkpoints of the same run and of the other seed’s run. The 193M change gave a legal-move mass of 0.59 at its own checkpoint, 0.61–0.62 at every later one with a rise in background loss of 0.04–0.05 nats, and 0.54 and 0.45 at 145M and 97M tokens. Across the checkpoints with a measured acquisition cost, the rank correlation between the recipient’s cost and the mass gained from the 290M change was − 0.95 -0.95 and − 0.77 -0.77 in the two seeds. The changes gave no gain at the other seed’s checkpoints, and neither did a Gaussian change with the norm of the return’s whole weight change in every tensor. The weight change of a permuted-rule return at 619M tokens, read out on the permuted rule, gave 0.61 at its own checkpoint and 0.41, 0.30, 0.16 and 0.11 at the four earlier ones. In two 64M source runs with 31 checkpoints each, the 226M change, 1.5% of the weight norm, gave 0.58 at the next checkpoint and 0.63–0.65 from 322M to 1.93B tokens with a rise in background loss of 0.01–0.02 nats, and the permuted-rule change from 226M tokens gave 0.62 at its own checkpoint, 0.37 at the next and 0.07 at the last (Fig. F1l–o).
blocks.zh: 在两次9.7M国际象棋来源赛中,目标在619M,290M,193M和97M-token的检查站随返回前的热身返回,每次返回在第一次评价时都停止,在第一次评价时检查的合法移动质量达到0.6,其重量变化被节省. 从每个检查站运行的控制在消息来源自己的目标上采取了同样数量的步骤,由于返回目标而产生的变化是两个重量变化之间的差别。 在没有经过培训的情况下,又在22个同一跑道和另外1个种子跑道上分别设立了检查站。 193M的改变给自己的检查站带来了0.59的法定移动质量,0.61–0.62在以后的每一个检查站,背景损失增加0.04–0.05纳特,145M和97M信使损失增加0.54和0.45。 在有计量购置成本的检查站,接受方成本与290M变化所得质量之间的排名关联为:0.95-0.95和0.77。 这些变化并没有给其他种子的检查站带来任何好处,而且高斯人也没有改变每一次返回时的全重变化。 在619M令牌上宣读的穿梭规则返回的重量变化,在自己的检查站给0.61,在前面的4个检查站给0.41,0.30,0.16和0.11。 在两个64M源的运行中,各设有31个检查站,226M的变换,占重量标准的1.5%,在下一个检查站给出0.58个,0.63–0.65个信使从322M增加到1.93B,背景损失增加0.01-0.02纳特,从226M信使的变换,在自己的检查站给出0.62个,在下一个检查站给出0.37个,在最后一个检查站给出0.07个(图F1l-o)。

blocks.en: 4.13 Returned targets at 7B
blocks.zh: 4.13 联合国 返回目标为7B

blocks.en: The 7B source model follows the recipe of models A and B with the targets of country capitals removed from the loss, together with agreement and repeated 4-gram targets, and every input kept, in seeds 0 and 1. Six snapshots between steps 2,048 and 12,817 are continued on the source model’s own data order. The capital targets return with the warm-up before the return, during which the source model’s masks apply. The acquisition level is a capital competence of 0.20; the fully supervised references end at 0.33 and 0.39. The reference of each seed is a fully supervised model with the recipe, data order and seed of its source model and the capital targets kept; it reaches the level after 1.67B tokens in seed 0 and 1.63B in seed 1, at a background loss of 3.22 nats in both. Capital competence is smoothed over five evaluations in logit, and the level is reached at the first upward crossing of the smoothed curve. The returns from steps 12,817, 8,192 and 5,793 reached the level after 1.8%, 11.0% and 15.2% of the reference’s tokens in seed 0 and after 1.1%, 12.3% and 22.3% in seed 1, and those from the three earlier steps did not reach it in either seed. The returns from step 12,817 start 0.013 and 0.017 nats below the lowest background loss of their reference, so their logit distance is read on model B of seed 0. The permuted assignment maps the first answer token of each capital through one fixed derangement of the 102 answer groups, and a matched true-rule control supervises the same positions with the true first token; both were run in seed 0 only. Agreement targets returned to the same six snapshots reached a competence of 0.85 after 2.7–5.6% of the tokens needed by model B of the same seed, which keeps the agreement targets (Fig. E1c,e). With only this token supervised, the permuted assignment needed 12.3, 3.9 and more than 1.4 times the tokens of the true assignment from steps 12,817, 8,192 and 4,096. A 7B model of seed 0 that keeps every target of the recipe, with the capital targets permuted from initialization, reached the level after 1.29 times the tokens of the seed-0 reference.
blocks.zh: 7B源模式采用模式A和B的配方,从损失中去除国家首都的目标,同时商定和重复4克目标,并保留每一份投入,以0和1号种子。 根据源模型自己的数据顺序,继续提供2 048至12 817步之间的6个快照。 资本的目标是在返回前的热身后返回,在此期间,源模型的面具适用。 购置水平是0.20的资本能力;完全监督的参考结果为0.33和0.39。 每个种子的参比是一个完全监督的模型,其食谱,数据顺序和种子来源模型以及保存的基建目标;在种子0的1.67B令牌和种子1的1.63B令牌之后达到水平,两者的背景损失为3.22纳特. 资本能力平滑在5个评价的对数中,平滑曲线第一次向上跨越时达到这一水平。 步骤12 817、8 192和5 793的回报率在种子0的参考物的1.8%、11.0%和15.2%之后达到水平,在种子1的参考物的1.1%、12.3%和22.3%之后达到水平,在任何种子中,前三个步骤的参考物都没有达到水平。 从第12,817步的返回开始0.013和0.017纳特低于其参考文献的最低背景损失,因此其登录距离在0种子的模型B上读取. 穿透式任务通过102个答题组一个固定的错位来映射每个首都的第一个答题符,一个匹配的真规则控制会用真第一符符来监督相同的位置;两者只运行在种子0中. 协议目标恢复到同样的6个快照,在2.7%-5.6%的同种种子的B型标本之后,达到了0.85的能力,保持协议目标(图E1c,e)。 仅监督这一标志,便需要12.817、8 192和4 096步骤的12.3、3.9和1.4倍以上的真正标志。 7B型0号种子模式保持了食谱的每个目标,资本目标从初始化中渗透出来,在种子参考物的1.29倍后达到水平.

blocks.en: 4.14 Domains returned after filtering
blocks.zh: 4.14 过滤后返回域

blocks.en: The Rust-filtered 7B model after 15,000 steps is continued with its optimizer state on the unfiltered corpus, at the same learning rate and batch, for 0.5B tokens on data blocks that neither it nor model B has read, and model B, the unfiltered model of Fig. 3f, is continued from its own state on the same blocks. Term accuracy on the Rust evaluation documents is smoothed over five evaluations in logit, and the gap is the mean of model B’s first five evaluations minus the filtered model’s accuracy at the return (0.764 and 0.517). For each fraction of the gap, the tokens after the return are divided by the tokens at which model B, evaluated on the same documents from initialization, first reached that accuracy. Half of the gap closed after 9.4M tokens against 450M from initialization, three quarters after 3.4% and nine tenths after 13%. Before the return the filtered model had read 259,000 reference-labelled Rust tokens, the Rust content of 117M tokens of the unfiltered stream; with these counted, its Rust tokens at the three points are 28%, 13% and 18% of those model B had read at the same accuracy. The data order of the 7B models reads rows that hold 55 of the 290 Rust evaluation documents. On the 235 that it does not read, the single-evaluation accuracies of model B and the filtered model at the return are 0.746 and 0.509, against 0.753 and 0.517 on all documents, and the fraction of the gap closed at each of seven saved states of the continuation is within 0.02 of its value on all documents. Working behaviour is scored on 212 Rust function tasks: ten completions per task are sampled at temperature 0.8, compiled with the hidden assertions and run in a sandbox, and compile and pass rates are fractions of the 2,120 completions. At the return the filtered model compiled 17.6% (95% interval 15.0–20.2) and model B 44.7% (40.4–49.1); after 500M tokens the values were 37.4% (33.2–41.4) and 41.1% (37.0–45.3).

blocks.en: At 20M–300M, models trained with one domain removed ( f = 0 f=0 , seed 0) were continued on the unfiltered stream for 300 steps of 128 sequences, with a new data order and a 32-step learning-rate warm-up, and evaluated every 10 steps (Fig. E2g). Shares follow the 7B rule, in reference-labelled domain tokens. The log 10 \log_{10} shares were fitted by maximum likelihood with censoring; the Chinese model at 300M is a lower bound (5.9%). A constant, − 1.33 ± 0.05 -1.33\pm 0.05 (4.7%) with a residual standard deviation of 0.17 dex, was preferred to a form with a size term ( + 0.02 ± 0.11 +0.02\pm 0.11 dex per tenfold increase) and gives a 95% prediction interval of 1.9–11.9% at 7B (Fig. 3e).

blocks.en: 4.15 Removal routes
blocks.zh: 4.15 清除路线

blocks.en: King safety is removed by four routes in 13 cases, each pairing a fully supervised chess model with a model of the same seed and training tokens trained without in-check targets, at 9.7M, 24M, 64M and 163M parameters and background losses of 1.65–1.96 nats, where the models of a case agree within 0.015 nats. The two withdrawn routes continue the fully supervised model without in-check targets for 8M and for 64M tokens; when the targets return, the models withdrawn for 64M tokens are up to 0.12 nats below the never-supervised model of their case and the others within 0.04. Unlearning either trains by gradient ascent on the in-check loss (weight 0.3) with descent on the remaining loss ( Jang et al., 2023 ) , or pushes the residual stream at in-check positions towards a fixed random direction while holding it to its value before unlearning elsewhere ( Li et al., 2024 ) ; both keep the state of lowest competence whose background loss is at most 0.05 nats above the start. Every model then starts from a fresh optimizer and receives the in-check targets with the warm-up before the return, at a share of 1, 0.1 or 0. The matched comparison enters the never-supervised trajectory of the same case at the legal-move probability mass from which the other model starts and compares the tokens each then needs to reach a mass of 0.6.
blocks.zh: 在13个案例中,King安全通过4条路线被移除,每条路线将一个完全监督的棋子模型与同一种子和训练品的模型配对,这些模型未经检查目标培训,其参数为9.7M,24M,64M和163M参数,背景损失为1.65–1.96纳特,案件模型在0.015纳特范围内一致. 两条被撤走的路线继续采用全监督模式,8M和64M令牌没有检查目标;当目标返回时,64M令牌被撤走的标牌最高为0.12纳特,低于从未监督过的案件模式,其他在0.04范围内. 要么通过梯度提高列车在检查损失(重量0.3)和剩余损失(Jang等人,2023年)上的下降,要么在检查位置将剩余溪流推向固定随机方向,同时在别处未学习之前保持其价值(Li等人,2024年);两者均保持本底损失最多高于起始点0.05纳特的最低能力状态。 然后每个模型从新的优化器开始,在返回前随热量得到检查中的目标,份额为1,0.1或0. 匹配的比较输入了同一案件从未监督的轨迹,其法律移动概率质量是另一个模型启动时的概率质量,并且比较了每个模型需要达到0.6的质量。

blocks.en: On web text the routes are applied to subject–verb agreement in 300M models of the Dolma recipe, two seeds at two background losses each. Gradient ascent uses the two-way cross-entropy of the auxiliary against its number partner (weight 0.3, learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , 64 sequences per step); with ascent on the full cross-entropy, as in chess, competence stayed above 0.87 (Fig. F1i–k). Withdrawal lowered competence to 0.65–0.74 and two-way ascent to 0.61–0.70, against 0.50–0.51 for never-supervised models, so the matched comparison of chess is made on competence ( n = 7 n=7 ). Returns follow the chess procedure with 64 sequences per step, the acquisition level is 0.85, and costs are divided by the tokens at which the fully supervised run of the same seed reaches it.
blocks.zh: 在网络文本中, 路径被应用到主题 - 动词协议中, 300M 模型的多尔玛食谱, 两个种子, 每个两个背景损失。 渐渐升起使用辅助器件的双向横琴对准其数合作伙伴(重量0.3,学习率10–4 10^{-4},每步64个序列);在全横琴上升起,如在围棋中,能力保持在0.87以上(F1i–k). 退出将能力降低至0.65–0.74,双向升至0.61–0.70,而从未接受过监督的型号则降为0.50–0.51,因此对国际象棋的对应比较是在能力上(n=7n=7). 返回遵循棋盘程序,每步64个序列,获得等级为0.85,成本除以完全监督的同一种子运行到达的符号.

blocks.en: In SMILES the routes are applied to ring closure in 9.7M and 24M models, two seeds each, at 6 and 14 tokens per parameter (eight cases), with the chess settings and 16 sequences per step. Withdrawal lowered competence from 0.86–0.91 to 0.01–0.04, gradient ascent stopped at 0.16–0.47 and misdirection at 0.09–0.14, against at most 0.002 for never-supervised models.
blocks.zh: 在SMILES中,路线适用于9.7M型和24M型的环形闭合,每型有2个种子,每个参数有6个和14个令牌(8个案例),棋盘设置和每步16个序列. 退出将能力从0.86-0.91降至0.01-0.04,梯度上升停止于0.16-0.47,方向错误于0.09-0.14,而从未监管的型号最多为0.002。

blocks.en: 4.16 Earlier supervision
blocks.zh: 4.16 早期监督

blocks.en: Two 9.7M chess models that kept 3% of in-check targets, and two trained on games filtered to a residual share of 3%, received all in-check targets with the warm-up before the return. The reference is the set of such returns to models trained without in-check targets, whose log 10 \log_{10} cost is fitted as a cubic in background loss before the first check with an intercept for each size. The effect of earlier supervision is the mean, over the two models that kept 3%, of each model’s mean residual from the reference fit, and the ratio of 0.25 is ten to the power of this effect. Its 95% interval uses the variance between and within source runs of the reference, estimated with each source run left out in turn (Fig. 5e).
blocks.zh: 两个9.7M的围棋模式保留了3%的验收目标,两个接受过游戏过滤到3%剩余份额的培训,在回归前随热身得到了所有验收目标. 参考的是未检查目标的模型的一组此类返回,在第一次检查之前,每个大小的截取器都装为背景损失的立方体。 早期监督的效果是,在两个模式中,每个模式的平均剩余量中,有3%来自参考值,0.25的比例是10。 其95%的间隔使用参考文献源流之间和内部的差异,估计每个来源依次被忽略(图5e)。

blocks.en: 4.17 Related king-safety positions
blocks.zh: 4.17 联合国 相关的国王安全立场

blocks.en: 4.18 Restricted returns, representation edit and stitched models
blocks.zh: 4.18 联合国 限制返回、表达式编辑和缝合模型

blocks.en: Restricted returns start from the lowest-loss checkpoint of two chess source runs at each of 9.7M, 24M and 64M parameters and use the warm-up before the return with only selected parameters trainable: one transformer block, the final norm and unembedding, or rank-1, -4 or -16 low-rank adapters ( Hu et al., 2021 ) on every block. Of three learning-rate multipliers (one, three and ten), the one with the cheapest permuted return was used for both rules. Costs are tokens to an in-check legal-move mass of 0.6 divided by those of the unrestricted return from the same checkpoint, and a run that does not reach 0.6 within half the tokens from initialization is a lower bound. The share of the saving kept is 1 − log 10 ⁡ ( cost ratio ) / log 10 ⁡ ( tokens from initialization / tokens of the unrestricted return ) 1-\log_{10}(\text{cost ratio})/\log_{10}(\text{tokens from initialization}/\text{tokens of the unrestricted return}) . Where both rules reached 0.6 under a restriction, the permuted rule needed 10–66 times more tokens.
blocks.zh: 限制返回从两个国际象棋源的最小损失检查点开始,每个9.7M,24M和64M参数,并在返回前使用热身,只使用可训练的选定参数:一个变压器块,最终规范与未嵌入,或排名1,-4或16低档适配器(Hu等人,2021年)在每个块上. 在三种学习率乘数(一、三和十)中,两种规则都使用了最廉价的乘数。 费用是检查后合法移动质量0.6除以从同一检查站不受限制地返回的重量的象征,从初始化算起未达到标志的一半之内的运行是较低的约束。 保存的储蓄份额为 1 — log 10 — (成本比率) / log 10 — (初始化的标志 / 无限制返回的标志 ) 1-\log 10} (\ text{ cost 比率} ) /\log 10} (\ text{ tokens from 初始化}/\ text{ tokens of the disatened return}) 。 如果两项规则在限制下达到0.6,则穿透的规则需要10-66倍的象征。

blocks.en: For the representation edit, distributed alignment search fitted a rank-8 subspace at the token where the move is predicted, in the block with the highest held-out interchange transfer, at three checkpoints of each of eight chess source runs (9.7M and 24M parameters, four seeds each). The readout is king-move sensitivity, log ⁡ p ⁡ ( K → s ∣ s ​ safe ) − log ⁡ p ⁡ ( K → s ∣ s ​ attacked ) \log p(K\to s\mid s\ \text{safe})-\log p(K\to s\mid s\ \text{attacked}) , on counterfactual position pairs from held-out games. The edit replaces the subspace by its mean at every token and removed 50–64% of the readout. Each checkpoint was continued with the edit or with a random rank-8 ablation, kept in place while the targets returned. The contrast is the paired difference in log 10 \log_{10} tokens to a legal-move mass of 0.6, averaged over a source run’s three checkpoints, with a 90% t t interval over the eight source runs (Fig. 5g and Fig. F1f–h).

Their costs are compared with the least-squares line of log cost against background loss at the return through the intact models of the same run (Fig. 5i).

blocks.en: 4.19 Statistics

The unit of replication is a training run from one initialization seed. The thinned models of the controlled domains have three to five seeds per size up to 64M parameters and one to three at 163M and 431M; designs with one or two source runs per size are stated in their sections. Web text has two seeds per design at 300M and 1B, three at 7B and four per size in the isolated contrasts; the capital returns at 7B have two seeds, and the document-filter pair at 1B, the Rust-filtered 7B model and the domain returns at 20M–300M are single runs at seed 0. The chess models trained on games without a check have one seed per size, and each set of replies in the transfer test has one run. Checkpoints of a run, and the returns that start from them, are repeated measurements of that run, so cost fits include a random intercept for each source run or standard errors clustered by source run. A value after ± \pm is a standard error, and intervals are 95% unless stated. Errors of the derived relation have intervals from resampling models. A run that does not reach a level within its budget is a lower bound at the tokens it ran, and a run at the level by its first evaluation is an upper bound. Bounds enter an ordering only where the order of the pair is identified, enter fits by maximum likelihood with censoring where stated, and are left out of least-squares fits of cost, as are runs without a reference trajectory and the Othello runs.
blocks.zh: 复制单位是从一个初始化种子进行的培训。 受控域的稀疏模型每个尺寸有3至5个种子,最高可达64M参数,163M和431M时有1至3个种子;每个尺寸有1至2个来源运行的设计在其部分中说明. Web文本在300M和1B的每个设计上有两个种子,三个在7B,每个大小在孤立的对比中四个;在7B的资本回报有两个种子,在1B的文档-过滤对,Rust-过滤的7B模型和在20M–300M的域名回报都是在种子0的单一运行. 在没有检查的情况下接受过比赛训练的棋子模型,每个尺寸有1个种子,转会测试中每组答题都有1个运行. 运行的检查点,以及从这些检查点开始的返回,是该运行的重复测量,所以成本适中包括每次源运行的随机截取或由源运行集群的标准错误. ±\\pm 之后的值是一个标准错误,除非声明,间隔为95% 。 衍生关系的误差与重印模型有间隔. 未达到预算水平的运行是其运行符的下限,其首次评估时的运行是上限. 只有在确定对子的顺序时,方能输入定单,在规定的情况下,通过审查以尽可能大的可能性进行输入,并且不计入成本,如没有参考轨迹的运行和Othello运行。

blocks.en: 4.20 Software

Experiments and analyses used PyTorch 2.12, NumPy 2.5, SciPy 1.18, python-chess 1.11.2, RDKit (2021.03 for corpus generation and 2026.09 for evaluation), SELFIES 2.2.0, Numba 0.68, spaCy 3.8.7 and HuggingFace tokenizers 0.23 and Transformers 5.19. Figures were rendered in inklet 4.9; chess pieces use the vector set by Colin M. L. Burnett distributed with python-chess. Large language model assistants (Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini and OpenAI Codex) were used under the authors’ direction to assist with training and analysis code, checks of the labellers and manuscript editing; the authors verified every reported result and take full responsibility for the content.

L. Burnett)所设定的矢量,以蟒蛇切片分布. 在作者的指导下,使用了大型语言模型助理(Anthropic Claude、Google Gemini和OpenAI Codex)来协助培训和分析代码,检查标签和手稿编辑;作者核实了每个报告结果,并对内容承担全部责任。

blocks.en: 4.21 Data availability
blocks.zh: 4.21 联合国 数据可用性

blocks.en: All training corpora are public or generated from a seed. Chess games are the rated games of January–August 2024 in the Lichess database ( https://database.lichess.org ). SMILES strings are the first 300M molecules of the Hugging Face dataset chandar-lab/ZINC_22 , without 830 that fail a SELFIES round trip, and the held-out molecules are from the last 3M of the same split. Web text is from HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-edu and from the tokenized Dolma 1.7 files of allenai/DataDecide-data-recipes . Othello games and Dyck-4 sequences are generated from a seed. The released code rebuilds the training streams, label arrays and held-out sets from these sources; its SMILES stream keeps the 830 molecules, so stream positions after the first of them differ from ours.
blocks.zh: 所有训练公司都是公开的或由种子产生的. 国际象棋游戏是利切斯数据库(https://database.licess.org)中2024年1月至8月的额定游戏. SMILES字符串是Hugging Face数据集 chandar-lab/ZINC_22的首款300M分子,没有830个失败SELFIES环游,被搁置的分子来自同一分数的最后3M. 网络文字来自HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-edu, 奥赛罗游戏和Dyck-4序列由种子产生. 所发布的代码重建了这些源头的训练流,标签阵列和挂起的套件;其SMILES流保留了830分子,因此流位在第一个分子之后与我们不同.

blocks.en: Code for building the corpora, training with target thinning, returning targets, the removal routes, document filtering and the fits of the thinning and cost relations is available at https://github.com/Mapika/progress-substitutes-data under the MIT licence. Its README lists the analyses that the release leaves out, among them the Rust function tasks and the transplanted weight changes, and the points at which a rerun differs from our runs.
