blocks.en: B.1 Domains and data
blocks.zh: B.1 领域和数据

blocks.en: Each controlled domain provides exact labels for its latent variables at every prefix, together with a deterministic verifier. Othello and Dyck-4 have an exact Bayes-optimal predictor, which gives the floor of the cross-entropy.
blocks.zh: 每个控制域在每一个前缀都为其潜在变量提供精确的标签,并配有一个确定性的验证器. Othello和Dyck-4有一个精确的Bayes-最优化的预测器,这给出了横切线的地板.

blocks.en: B.2 Models and training
blocks.zh: B.2 模式和培训

blocks.en: The seven base sizes have 0.755M, 2.21M, 4.82M, 9.67M, 24.4M, 64.4M and 162.8M non-embedding parameters. FineWeb-Edu models train with weight decay 0.1 and gradient clipping at 1. On the Dolma recipe the learning rate at 1B is half that of the 20M–300M models, and the learning rate at 7B was selected by the lowest loss after 700 steps among three rates. Models A and B stop at 3.4B and 3.9B tokens.
blocks.zh: 7个基号有0.755M,2.21M,4.82M,9.67M,24.4M,64.4M和162.8M非嵌入参数. FineWeb-Edu型号列车,重量衰减0.1,梯度剪切速度为1. 在Dolma食谱上,1B的学习率是20M-300M模型的一半,7B的学习率是在三个速率中700步之后的最低损失率选择的。 模型 A和B停在3.4B和3.9B的令牌.

blocks.en: B.3 Competence, background loss and target thinning
blocks.zh: B.3 能力、背景损失和目标缩小

blocks.en: Masked positions are excluded from the numerator and the denominator of the training loss, so every other target keeps its loss term and its weight relative to the thinned targets changes. A run that does not reach an onset level is censored at its final background loss, which is an upper bound on the background loss at which the level would be crossed.
blocks.zh: 蒙面位置不包含在训练损失的计数器和分母中,因此其他每个目标都保持其损失期和相对于稀薄目标重量的变化. 未达到启动级的跑步在最后背景损失时受到审查,这是跨越该级的背景损失的上限。

blocks.en: Background loss as the index (Fig. B1). For each skill, the logit competence of fully supervised runs is fitted as a cubic in background loss (fifth degree for web text) on seed 0 of the smaller sizes, and the other seeds and the larger sizes are scored from that fit. Over the 98 runs left out of the fits, across 21 skills, the median absolute residual is 0.031 logits, and it is at most 0.16 logits for the 21 runs of 100M parameters or more.
blocks.zh: 背景损失作为指数(图B1)。 对于每种技能,完全监督运行的登录能力在较小的0号种子上作为背景损失的立方(网络文本为第五度)安装,其他种子和较大大小的种子则从这个位置打分。 超过98个赛跑,超过21个技能,绝对剩余中位数为0.031对数,最多为0.16对数,为21个赛跑100M参数或以上。

blocks.en: Loss weight against thinning (Fig. B2h). In 9.7M chess models, two seeds, every in-check target is given a loss weight of 0.1, or 10% of in-check targets are kept at full weight. Both divide the summed loss by the number of eligible targets. The weighted minus the thinned logit competence at matched background loss, between 1.85 and 2.80 nats, is + 0.009 +0.009 logits ( + 0.002 +0.002 and + 0.016 +0.016 in the two seeds).
blocks.zh: 消瘦减重(图B2h)。 在9.7M国际象棋模型中,有2个种子,每个参赛目标都得到0.1的减重,或者10%的参赛目标保持满重. 两者将总损失除以合格目标的数目。 相匹配背景损失时的加权减薄对数能力在1.85至2.80纳特之间,为+0.009+0.009对数(在两种种子中为+0.002+0.002和+0.016+0.016)。

blocks.en: Delay curve and size term (Fig. B3). The pooled delay curve is a least-squares fit of Δ ​ L = b ⁡ ( 1 − f c ) \Delta L=b\,(1-f^{c}) to the 50 thinned chess runs with an onset at q = 0.75 q=0.75 , across all sizes and both schedules, with b = 0.77 ± 0.07 b=0.77\pm 0.07 , c = 0.28 ± 0.03 c=0.28\pm 0.03 and a root-mean-square error of 0.020 nats. For the warm-up–stable–decay runs, tokens to onset are read by linear interpolation between snapshots at the background loss of onset. The size term is the slope of the delay against log 10 \log_{10} parameters at a fixed fraction, pooled over fractions. On the constant learning rate it is 0.033 ± 0.006 0.033\pm 0.006 , 0.014 ± 0.007 0.014\pm 0.007 and 0.002 ± 0.007 0.002\pm 0.007 nats per tenfold increase in size at q = 0.70 q=0.70 , 0.75 and 0.80, and on the warm-up–stable–decay schedule − 0.003 ± 0.009 -0.003\pm 0.009 and − 0.010 ± 0.011 -0.010\pm 0.011 at q = 0.75 q=0.75 and 0.80. At q = 0.659 q=0.659 , on the plateau of the fully supervised trajectories, it is 0.062 ± 0.009 0.062\pm 0.009 and 0.040 ± 0.010 0.040\pm 0.010 on the two schedules. Onsets are therefore read at q ≥ 0.70 q\geq 0.70 .

blocks.en: B.4 Derived thinning relation
blocks.zh: B.4 衍生变薄关系

blocks.en: Appendix A gives the derivation. Errors of the derived offsets are taken over 1.85–2.80 nats at 9.7M and 1.85–2.05 nats at 64M. The sensitivity fitted to the pooled offsets at each background loss, across 2.2M–431M and both schedules, is 0.55–0.67, with κ \kappa and τ \tau fitted within a shared window of background loss and κ \kappa resampled across runs. The slope of pooled logit competence against ln ⁡ f \ln f is κ ​ f / ( f + τ ) \kappa f/(f+\tau) , so τ \tau is the fraction at which the response to proportional thinning halves. Fitted across sizes with the pooled sensitivity, ln ⁡ τ \ln\tau changes by + 0.03 +0.03 for each tenfold increase in parameters (95% interval − 0.05 -0.05 to + 0.09 +0.09 ) over 2.2M–431M at fixed background loss. In the fit of the horizontal shift, A k ​ ( 1 − f p ) A_{k}(1-f^{p}) , each of the 18 skills has its own amplitude A k A_{k} and the exponent p p is shared; the fit is tested on another seed and on eight skills at 24M (Fig. B2c–g).
blocks.zh: 附 录 A给出的推论。 得出抵消的误差为9.7M的1.85-2.80纳特,64M的1.85-2.05纳特。 每一次背景损失,在2.2M-431M和两个附表中,与集合抵消相适应的敏感度为0.55-0.67,在共享的背景损失窗口内安装了 $\kappa 和 \tau ,并在 $\kappa 上重新进行全天下取样。 集合对数能力相对于 QQ f\ln f 的斜率为 $ f / (f + τ )\ kappa f/ (f+\ tau), 因此 \ tau 是比例稀释半径反应的分数 。 大小与集合敏感度相适应,在固定背景损失时,参数每增加10倍(95%间隔-0.05 - 0.05 + 0.09 + 0.01M ),变化为+0.03 + 0.03。 在水平转动的适中,Ak(1–f)A_{k}(1-f^{p}),18个技能中每个技能都有自己的振幅Ak A_{k},并分享开局p;在24M(图B2c–g)测试另一个种子和8个技能的适中.

blocks.en: B.5 Held-out predictions
blocks.zh: B.5 延期预测

blocks.en: The four chess tests hold out fractions below 0.1 (28 trajectories in 8 groups that share a fully supervised trajectory), model sizes (99 in 12), the constant-learning-rate schedule (17 in 5) and the 1.28B and 3.0B models (2 in 2), and the error is pooled within each test.
blocks.zh: 4个国际象棋测试将分数控制在0.1以下(28个轨迹共8组,拥有完全受监督的轨迹),模型尺寸(99个在12个),恒定学习率表(17个在5个)和1.28B和3.0B模型(2个在2个),错误在每次测试内集合.

blocks.en: On web text, onsets are read against the held-out background loss outside all thinned targets, and the response is calibrated with censored fits of onset = g ⁡ ( f ) + d ​ log 10 ⁡ ( N N ¯ ) + e cell + e seed , g ⁡ ( f ) = g 1 + a ​ ln ​ f , \text{onset}=g(f)+d\,\log_{10}\!\left(\frac{N}{\bar{N}}\right)+e_{\text{cell}}+e_{\text{seed}},\qquad g(f)=g_{1}+a\ln f, (B1) where N N is the number of parameters, N ¯ \bar{N} the geometric-mean size, d d the size term and e cell e_{\text{cell}} and e seed e_{\text{seed}} random effects. Nested closing is an evaluation subset of the closing mask. Neither 7B model is fully supervised on every skill, so each skill is compared across the two models, which differ in several thinned families at once; the isolated contrasts change one family at a time. The error of 0.058 nats is the mean, over the six skills and the three seeds, of each seed’s mean absolute difference between predicted and observed onset shift at competence levels 0.3–0.7 (0.055, 0.061 and 0.057 for the three seeds). The same two designs give 0.067 nats at 300M and 0.063 at 1B, with two seeds each.
blocks.zh: 在网络文本中,在读取所有稀疏目标外的被搁置背景损失时,会读取发端,并用经过审查的发端匹配=g  (f) + d log 10⁡ (N̄) + e cell + e 种子, g⁡ (f) = g 1 + a in f,\text{onset}=g(f) + d\,\log_{ 10}\ !\ left(\frac{N}{\bar{N}}\r}}\right) + e_{\ text{ celle_{\ _{\ {_{\ _{\ text{ \,\qquad}}! g(f)=g_{1}+a\ln f, (B1) 其中N是参数数,N'\bar{N}是几何-平均值大小,d是大小名词和e细胞 e_{\text{cell}和e种子 e_{\text{seed}随机效果. 嵌入式闭合是闭合口罩的一个评价子集. 7B模式在每种技能上都没有得到充分监督,因此每种技能在两种模式中进行比较,在几个瘦小的家庭一次不同;孤立的对比一次改变一个家庭. 0.058纳特的误差是每个种子在能力水平0.3-0.7(三种种子的0.055、0.061和0.057)的预测和观测到的起落变化之间的平均绝对差数,相对于6个技能和3个种子而言。 同样的两种设计在300M时给出0.067纳特,在1B时给出0.063纳特,每方有2个种子.

blocks.en: In the isolated contrasts every other family is fully supervised, and within a seed the three runs share initialization, data order and mask hashes. Runs train to 2B tokens at 150M and 3B at 300M, and the agreement-thinned runs to 1B. The 150M offset, as a function of background loss, is added to each 300M seed’s fully supervised trajectory with a 95% predictive band of ± t 0.975 , 3 ​ σ ^ ​ 1.25 \pm t_{0.975,3}\,\hat{\sigma}\sqrt{1.25} from the four 150M seeds, and beyond the 150M range of background loss the offset at the edge is held.
B.6 Document filtering
blocks.zh: B.6 文件过滤

blocks.en: In chess, 163M models were trained at f = 1 f=1 and 0. The delay ratio at a residual share is the delay of the filtered model divided by the delay of the model with in-check targets thinned to the same share, both read from the interval regression of onset on the loss before the first check at a legal-move mass of 0.6. It is 0.87 at a share of 0.1 (0.84–0.90 over sizes and seeds) and 0.78 at 0.03 (0.77–0.80). In SMILES, removing whole molecules brings ring closure 0.19 nats earlier than masking its targets when both are read on the shared background loss, and 0.05 nats later on each run’s own training mixture (Fig. B4e).
blocks.zh: 在国际象棋中,163M型在f=1f=1和0. 剩余份额的延迟比率是被过滤模型的延迟除以在检查中的目标被稀释到相同份额的延迟,两者均从第一次检查前的发生时间间隔回归读取,合法移动质量为0.6. 它在0.1(0.84-0.90 大于大小和种子)和0.08(0.77-0.80)的比例下为0.87。 在SMILES中,移除整个分子比在共同背景损失上阅读时掩盖其目标更早于环闭合0.19纳特,在每次运行的训练混合物(图B4e)上更晚0.05纳特。

blocks.en: In web text, the Chinese label is the share of CJK characters, excluding kana and hangul. The classifiers have average precisions of 0.88, 0.98 and 0.98 for astronomy, Rust and Chinese, and at f = 0 f=0 every reference-labelled document is removed as well. The Latin-square runs are accompanied by runs with thinned domain targets and with a random residual (Fig. E2b). The realised share of the 7B Rust filter is 0.029. The background loss of the document-filtering runs leaves out the held-out targets in documents that resemble the three domains, about 2.6% of the targets. Onsets are read at half of each domain’s competence range. The effect of each filter on the other two domains is the onset fitted for a domain at its own share and size minus the observed onset, plotted against the share kept by the other filter; the means lie within 0.03 nats of zero (Fig. E2e). The pair of 1B models filtered to f = 0.03 f=0.03 delays astronomy, Rust and Chinese by 0.62, 0.97 and 0.29 nats.
blocks.zh: 在网络文本中,中文标签是CJK字符的分享,不包括kana和hunkul. 分类器平均精度为0.88,0.98和0.98,对天文学,鲁斯特和汉语来说,在f=0f=0时,每个有参考标记的文档也被移除. 拉丁方的运行伴有带有稀疏域靶的运行,并带有随机残存(图E2b). 7B Rust过滤器的实现份额为0.029。 文件过滤的背景损失忽略了类似三个领域的文件中被搁置的目标,约占目标的2.6%。 每个域的权限范围的一半读取 Onset 。 每个过滤器对另外两个域的影响是,一个域的启动量按自己的份额和大小减去观察到的启动量,与另一个过滤器所保存的份额相对应;其手段在0.03纳特为零(图E2e)。 过滤成f=0.03 f=0.03的1B模型对延迟天文学,Rust和Chinese以0.62,0.97和0.29 nats.

blocks.en: Appendix C Outputs of a never-supervised model
blocks.zh: 附录C 无监督模式的产出

blocks.en: C.1 Output classes at the skill’s positions
blocks.zh: C.1 联合国 技能岗位的输出课程

blocks.en: The eight classes are: legal king move; legal capture of the checking piece, by the king or by another piece; legal interposition; move of another piece that obeys the piece-movement rules and leaves the king attacked only by the checking piece, which would be legal if the king were not in check; king move to an attacked square; move that exposes the king to a further piece; token that is not a move of the position; and end-of-game and padding tokens. The legal classes coincide with the legal moves at every position. Probabilities are means over positions with 95% intervals from 1,000 bootstrap resamples of games.
blocks.zh: 这八个等级是: 合法国王移动; 合法夺取检查块,由国王或另一块; 合法干涉; 移动另一块,服从检查块规则,只让国王受到检查块的攻击,如果国王不检查的话,这是合法的; 国王移动到一个被攻击的广场上; 移动使国王暴露在另一块; 象征性的不是位置的移动; 游戏结束和装饰符号. 法律等级与每个职位的法律动作一致。 概率是指在1000个游戏的靴子复制品中间隔95%的位置之上.

blocks.en: At its last snapshot, at a background loss of 1.62 nats, the 64M model trained without in-check targets placed 0.48 (0.47–0.49) of its probability on moves that ignore the check. The share was 0.46–0.50 at every background loss below 2.2 nats, in both sizes and both 9.7M seeds. Among the legal replies, its most probable reply was the move played at 0.636 of the 7,149 positions with two or more legal replies, against 0.676 for the fully supervised model and 0.304 by chance; at 9.7M the values were 0.591 and 0.594 for the two seeds against 0.619–0.636 for three fully supervised seeds.
blocks.zh: 在最后一张快照中,在1.62纳特的背景损失中,64M型在未检查目标的情况下受训的机型将其概率的0.48(0.47-0.49)投放在忽略检查的动作上. 在2.2纳特以下的每一次背景损失中,份额为0.46-0.50,大小和种子均为9.7M。 在法律答复中,最可能的答复是7 149个职位中有0.636个职位得到2个或更多的法律答复,而完全监督的模型为0.676个,偶然的为0.304个;两个种子的数值为9.791和0.594,完全监督的种子为0.619-0.636。

blocks.en: The returns of Fig. 2c start from an early and a late snapshot of each source run, with the warm-up before the return. In the return from the last 64M snapshot, the probability on moves that ignore the check fell from 0.48 to 0.14 within eight steps, the probability on legal king moves rose from 0.20 to 0.47 and the legal-move mass from 0.44 to 0.73. The gain in legal-move mass over the first eight steps was 0.18 and 0.24 at 9.7M, from snapshots at 1.99 and 1.83 nats, and 0.23 and 0.30 at 64M, from snapshots at 1.95 and 1.62 nats.
blocks.zh: Fig. 2c的返回从每个源运行的早期和晚期的快照开始,返回前的热身. 在从最后的64M快照的回报中,忽略支票的动作的概率在8个步骤内从0.48降至0.14,合法王动的概率从0.20升至0.47,合法移动的质量从0.44升至0.73. 在前8个步骤中,从1.99和1.83纳特的快照到1.95和1.62纳特的快照到0.23和0.30的快照,从9.7M得到0.18和0.24。

blocks.en: At the last snapshot of the 9.7M SMILES model trained without ring-closure targets, at 0.498 nats, 0.735 of the probability lay on an atom, 0.228 on opening a branch and 0.0004 on the true closing digit. After all ring-closure targets returned to that snapshot, at 16 sequences per step, the true digit had a probability of 0.043 after one step, 0.36 after two and 0.60 after 12.
blocks.zh: 在9.7M SMILES模型上一个没有环闭目标训练的快照中,0.498纳特,概率的0.735位于一个原子上,0.228位于打开一个分支,0.04位于真正的关闭数字上. 在所有的环闭合目标返回到该快照之后,每步16个序列,真实的数位数的概率为每步0.043,两步后0.36,12步后0.60.

blocks.en: C.2 Chess games without a check
blocks.zh: C.2 联合国 棋局没有支票

blocks.en: Stream and positions. The stream keeps, in order, every game of the chess training stream in which a replay finds no position with the side to move in check: 9.1% of games, with a mean length of 43 moves against 70 for games with a check. Each evaluation prompt runs from the separator to the checking move of the first check of a held-out game. The reference checkpoints are within 0.03 nats of the model trained on games without a check in held-out loss before the first check. The ranking by move frequency counts moves by side to move in the first 600M tokens of the stream. Table C1 gives every measure for the four sizes.
blocks.zh: 流和位置。 串流按顺序保留每一场棋类训练串流的棋子,其中复出后找不到与侧面移动的姿势: 游戏的9.1%,平均长度为43个动作,对70个带有检查的游戏. 每个评价提示从分隔符到检查被搁置游戏的第一个检查动作. 参考检查点位于接受游戏训练的模型的0.03纳特以内,第一次检查前没有检查被搁置的损失。 通过移动频率的排名计数在溪流前600M令牌中同时移动. 表C1为四个尺寸的每个尺度。

blocks.en: Moves of the same piece. At each first check, a legal reply is paired with a move from the same square that obeys the piece-movement rules and leaves the king attacked, and the score is the share of pairs in which the legal reply has the higher logit, with ties counted as one half, averaged over the pairs of a game and then over games. With both moves restricted to moves of a piece other than the king that neither capture, promote nor give check, the legal reply is an interposition (847 games, 9,988 pairs). The 9.7M model trained on games without a check preferred it in 0.772 of comparisons (95% interval 0.757–0.787), against 0.561 for the ranking by move frequency.
blocks.zh: 移动同一块。 每次第一次检查时,都会将一个法律回执与从同一方位的动作配对,该方位服从棋盘移动规则,让国王受到攻击,得分是法律回执中拥有较高对数的对数的对数份额,关系计算为一半,平均在一局对数上,然后在一局对数上. 这两种动作都仅限于国王以外的一个既不捕捉,促进也不给检查的棋子的动作,法律回执是插座(847游戏,9,988对). 在没有检查的情况下接受游戏训练的9.7M型在比较(95%间隔0.757–0.787)的0.772中首选,而按移动频率的排名为0.561.

blocks.en: Board pairs. One prompt is kept for each distinct position (1,681; piece placement, side to move, castling and en-passant rights), the shortest and then the first in the set. For two moves A A and B B of a pair, the shift measure asks whether the logit of A A minus that of B B is larger on the board where A A is legal than on the board where B B is legal; a ranking that does not depend on the board scores one half on it and zero on the share of pairs with the legal move preferred on both boards. Several pairs of moves on the same two boards are averaged. Intervals resample the 1,162 contributing games 2,000 times, and a board pair is weighted by the product of the counts of its two games.
blocks.zh: 板对. 每个不同位置(1 681个;件件安放、侧移、阉割和被动权利)各有一个提示,最短,然后是一组中的第一个。 对于一对的A和B两个动作,班次测量法询问A的A减B在A是合法的棋盘上是否比B的棋盘上更大;一个排名不取决于棋盘对它得分一半,对对两个棋盘上偏好的合法棋盘的对分为零. 同一两块板上的几对动作是平均的. Intervals重现了1,162个贡献游戏2000次,一个棋盘对子被其两个游戏的计数产品加权.

blocks.en: Transfer between replies (Fig. C1). Each training example is a prefix of a game outside the evaluation set that ends at the first check of the game, with one loss, on the reply played. The three sets of replies are checks by a single knight, checks by a single bishop, rook or queen whose every legal reply interposes a piece, and first checks of any kind; the two controls are the moves two plies earlier in the knight games, with the same side to move, and the knight replies shuffled among positions with the same side to move. Each run takes 96 updates of 32 prefixes with a new AdamW state, a learning rate of 4 × 10 − 4 4\times 10^{-4} after a ten-update warm-up, no weight decay and gradient clipping at 1. First checks of the training prefixes fall between plies 4 and 159, and positions shared with the evaluation set are excluded. The five sets hold 3,072 prefixes from distinct games and differ in prefix length. Intervals resample the evaluation games 10,000 times, with all runs and both evaluations of a game kept together, and describe one run per set. At the 92 positions where every legal reply blocks, legal-move mass changed by − 0.040 -0.040 ( − 0.060 -0.060 to − 0.020 -0.020 ) after the replies to knight checks, by the same amount after the ordinary moves (difference + 0.000 +0.000 , − 0.030 -0.030 to + 0.031 +0.031 ), by + 0.235 +0.235 (0.181–0.289) after first checks of any kind and by + 0.506 +0.506 (0.449–0.564) after forced blocks. At the 326 knight checks it was 0.569 before and 0.897, 0.551, 0.861 and 0.616 after the knight replies, the forced blocks, the first checks of any kind and the ordinary moves. Knight replies shuffled among positions lowered it to 0.139 at knight checks and 0.019 at forced blocks. At the 860 positions where a block is among the legal replies, the replies to knight checks raised legal-move mass from 0.443 to 0.583.

blocks.en: Appendix D Acquisition cost and the cost relation
blocks.zh: 附录D 购置费用和费用关系

blocks.en: D.1 Acquisition cost after targets return
blocks.zh: D.1 目标回报后的购置费用

blocks.en: Stored checkpoints hold the weights only, so the optimizer state is rebuilt at every return. Costs count the tokens after the targets return. The steps that rebuild the optimizer state contain none of the returned targets and are not charged; charging them gives 3.1–7.5% for the chess source runs at their lowest-loss checkpoints (Fig. D1e). With the warm-up at the return, no parameter update precedes the returned targets (Fig. D1b).
blocks.zh: 存储的检查站只持有重量,因此每次返回时都会重建优化状态. 成本在目标返回后计数符号. 重建优化状态的步骤没有包含任何返回的目标,也不收费;在最低损失的检查站(图D1e)为棋源提供3.1-7.5 %。 随着返回时的温暖,在返回的目标(图D1b)之前没有参数更新.

blocks.en: Chess. Returns use the peak learning rate of the main recipe, 0.004. A run stops after two consecutive evaluations with king-safety competence q q at or above 0.80 for s = 1 s=1 and 0.70 for smaller shares, or at its token budget. Budgets grow as the returned share falls: 40M tokens at s = 1 s=1 , 60M at 0.3, 80M–200M at 0.1 and 100M–200M at 0.03; two returns at s = 0.3 s=0.3 and 0.1 ran with the 40M budget. The 198 chess returns of the cost relation are the 110 returns with the warm-up before the return, the 82 returns with the warm-up at the return whose checkpoint and share have no return with the warm-up before it, and six returns of all targets from 9.7M and 64M checkpoints at 2.99–3.99 nats, which use the warm-up before the return and a budget of 150M tokens. The two chess scores cross their levels together: at the first crossing of q = 0.659 q=0.659 in a return, the legal-move mass has a median of 0.60, with 10th and 90th percentiles of 0.56 and 0.61 across 326 runs.
blocks.zh: 国际象棋. 回归使用主食谱的峰值学习率,0.004. 运行在连续两次评估后停止,其王安全能力q q 等于或大于0.80, s = 1 s = 1,小股0.70,或象征性预算。 预算随着回归份额的下降而增长:40M令牌在s=1s=1,60M为0.3,80M–200M为0.1,100M–200M为0.03;两次回报在s=0.3s=0.3,0.1与40M预算运行. 成本关系的198个棋盘回归是:110个与回归前的热身回归,82个与回归时的热身回归,其检查站和分享与其之前的热身无法回归,以及9.7M和64M检查站所有目标在2.99–3.99纳特的6个回归,使用回归前的热身回归以及150M令牌的预算. 两种棋子的分数共同跨越等级:在第一次通过q = 0.659 q = 0.659的回转时,合法移动质量的中位数为0.60,其中第10位和第90位百分位数为0.56,0.61横跨326跑.

blocks.en: Web text. The eleven source models are seed 0 at 9.7M, 24M, 64M and 163M, seeds 1 and 2 at 9.7M–64M and seed 1 at 163M. After the moments are estimated the first moment is set to zero, and the 30 steps on the source model’s own targets run at the learning rate of the source schedule, 0.008. Targets return from 7–9 checkpoints of each source run. Evaluations fall at steps 0–6, 8, 10, 12, 14 and 16 and then at steps 15% apart. A run stops once competence is at 0.90, or at twice the steps of its first evaluation at or above 0.85 with at least 24 steps, or at its budget, which is 60M tokens for returns near or above the acquisition loss and 30M otherwise; every run reached the level.
blocks.zh: 网易网讯. 11种来源型号为:种子0在9.7M,24M,64M和163M,种子1和2在9.7M–64M,种子1在163M. 在估计了这些时刻之后,第一个时刻被设定为零,源模型自身目标的30个步骤以源计划学习速度运行,0.08. 目标从每个来源的7至9个检查站返回。 评估分为0-6、8、10、12、14和16步,然后是15%。 一旦能力达到0.90,或者在0.85或0.85或以上,或在其预算中,运行停止,至少24个步骤,即接近或高于购置损失的回报值为60M,否则为30M;每次运行达到水平。

blocks.en: SMILES. Returns continue the data order of the source run at a learning rate of 0.004. Evaluations fall when the targets return and then at steps spaced by a factor of 1.25. A run stops after two consecutive evaluations at 0.75 or above (0.7 at shares below 1) or at a budget of 20M, 30M, 60M and 100M tokens for shares of 1, 0.3, 0.1 and 0.03.
blocks.zh: 尖叫声。 返回以0.004的学习速度继续源运行的数据顺序。 评估在目标返回时下降,然后按1.25的系数进行。 连续两次评估后,运行停止,时间为0.75或以上(0.7分,份额低于1),或为20M、30M、60M和100M令牌,份额为0.3、0.1和0.3。

blocks.en: Othello. The eight source runs are four at 9.7M (two seeds trained with none of the forced-pass targets, and one each with 10% and 30%), two at 24M (none and 10%) and two at 64M (10% and 30%), and their checkpoints lie at background losses of 2.12–2.86 nats. Returns use a learning rate of 0.004, with the moments estimated over 20 steps without parameter updates, and are evaluated on the chess schedule. A run stops after two consecutive evaluations at 0.6 or above. Eleven runs were at the level when the targets returned and are counted as one step, and three more reached it within the first step; these fourteen are upper bounds.
blocks.zh: 奥赛罗 八个来源在9.7M时有四个(两个种子经过训练,没有强制通过的目标,每个种子有10%和30%),两个在24M时(无10%),两个在64M时(10%和30%),其检查站的背景损失为2.12-2.86纳特。 回归使用0.004的学习率,瞬间估计超过20个步骤,没有参数更新,并在棋盘表上进行评估. 连续两次评价后,在0.6或以上停止运行。 目标返回时有11次跑步,被算作一步,第一步内还有3次到达;这14次是上限.

blocks.en: D.2 Logit distance and the cost relation
blocks.zh: D.2 逻辑距离和费用关系

blocks.en: The reference has a seed other than that of the source run for 50 chess, 21 web-text and 2 Othello runs. References cover 186 of 198 chess runs, 88 of 90 web-text runs, 66 of 73 SMILES runs and 50 of 53 Othello runs. For the progress term and the split at L ∗ ​ ( s ) L^{*}(s) , the acquisition loss is read from one curve per domain, fitted across sizes and returned shares in chess, across returned shares at 9.7M in SMILES and across sizes in web text; it lies within 0.04 nats of the value from the same-size reference in chess and SMILES and within 0.08 nats in web text.

blocks.en: Table D1 gives the fits. In SMILES the rate is 0.74 ± 0.21 0.74\pm 0.21 , 0.57 ± 0.10 0.57\pm 0.10 , 0.47 ± 0.08 0.47\pm 0.08 and 0.52 ± 0.09 0.52\pm 0.09 decades per logit at 9.7M, 24M, 64M and 163M. The 13 returns of all ring-closure targets from a logit distance below − 1.3 -1.3 reached the level within 14–20 steps, inside the 20-step warm-up, at every size; without the returns of 25 steps or fewer the rate is 0.56 ± 0.18 0.56\pm 0.18 . For the 56 runs returned above the acquisition loss with a positive logit distance that reached the level in chess, web text and SMILES, the background loss at which they reached the acquisition level differed from L ∗ ​ ( s ) L^{*}(s) by a median of 0.04 nats in chess and web text and 0.01 nats in SMILES (Fig. D2h), and the two-part form with the single line gave their costs with a median absolute error of 0.17 dex. Across seven acquisition levels in chess the rate is 0.78–1.20 decades per logit (Fig. D2b). The standard errors of the single line and of the trend with model size are clustered by source run. One never-supervised Othello return, from a checkpoint 1.5 logits above the acquisition loss, did not reach the level within 306 steps. In the near-floor ordering a higher score counts as a lower predicted cost.
blocks.zh: 表D1给出了符合条件。 在SMILES中,0.74±0.21 0.74\pm 0.21,0.57±0.10 0.57\pm 0.10,0.47±0.08 0.47\pm 0.08和0.52±0.09 0.52\pm 0.09 几十年的登录时间为9.7M,24M,64M和163M. 从 − 1.3 - 1.3 下的对数距离下,所有环闭目标共13个返回,在 − 20 步内,在 − 20 步内,以每个大小达到水平;没有 − 0.56 ± 0.18 0.56\ pm 0.18 的返回率. 对于在收购损失上方返回的56次运行,其正对数距离达到国际象棋,网络文字和SMILES的水平,其达到收购水平的背景损失与L * (s) LQQ(s)在围棋和网络文字中的中位数为0.04纳特,在SMILES中的中位数为0.01纳特(Fig. D2h),单行的双部分形式给出了成本,其中位绝对错误为0.17 dex. 围棋的7个收购级别中,每对数的比率为0.78-1.20年(图D2b)。 单行的标准错误和有模型大小的趋势,按源运行分组. 一次从未受到监督的Othello返回,从采购损失上方的1.5个检查站记录,没有达到306步内的水平。 在近地板订购中,较高的分数算作较低的预计成本。

blocks.en: D.3 Batch size and learning rate at the return
blocks.zh: D.3 批量大小和返回时的学习率

blocks.en: The three checkpoints of each size are the first stored checkpoint at or below the acquisition loss, the lowest-loss checkpoint and the one nearest the midpoint of the two in background loss. Every setting is evaluated at every step up to step 40. The runs from initialization have two seeds at 9.7M and 24M and one at 64M. Table D2 gives every cost.
blocks.zh: 每个大小的三个检查站是购置损失或低于购置损失的第一个储存检查站、最低损失的检查站和背景损失的两个检查站中点最近的检查站。 每一步到40步都要评价每个设置。 从初始化开始的跑道有两个种子,分别是9.7M和24M和64M. 表D2列出每项费用。

blocks.en: Training from initialization needed 0.55–0.66 times the tokens at 16 sequences and 2.2–3.3 times at 256. At the standard learning rate, the five returns of 25–216 optimizer steps needed 1.1–1.65 times the tokens at 16 sequences, in 4.3–6.6 times as many steps, and 1.5–2.2 times the tokens at 256 sequences. With 16 sequences at one third of the learning rate, the tokens were 0.71–1.07 times those of the standard setting at 2.8–4.3 times the steps. Returns that finish within ten optimizer steps needed fewer tokens at 16 sequences, 0.42–0.94 times, so the costs of 0.10–0.78% from the lowest-loss checkpoints are upper estimates of the data required. From the lowest-loss checkpoints the cost was 0.15–1.35% of the tokens from initialization at the same setting across the five settings. The slope of log 10 \log_{10} relative cost against the logit distance of the checkpoint was 0.86–1.29 decades per logit at the four other settings, and the single line of Fig. 4b gave the relative costs at the five settings with mean errors of − 0.40 -0.40 to − 0.12 -0.12 dex. From initialization the permuted rule needed 1.03–1.13 times the tokens of the true rule at these settings.
blocks.zh: 初始化后的培训需要16个序列的0.55-0.66倍,256个序列的2.2-3.3倍。 按照标准学习速度,25–216优化步骤的5个返回需要1.1–1.65倍于16个序列的符号,在4.3–6.6倍于多步,在256个序列的符号为1.5–2.2倍. 16个序列占学习率的三分之一,符号是标准设定的0.71–1.07倍,是步骤的2.8–4.3倍。 在10个优化步骤内完成的返回需要16个序列的更少的代号,为0.42-0.94倍,因此最低损失检查站0.10-0.78%的费用是所需数据的上限估计。 从最低损失的检查站看,在五种情况下在同一情况下初始化的费用为0.15%-1.35%。 log 10\log 10} 相对于检查站的日志距离, 相对成本为 0. 86 - 1. 29 年 其他四个设置的日志, 单行图 4b 给出了五个设置的相对成本, 平均误差为 − 0.40 - 0.40 到 − 0.12-0.12 度。 从初始化开始,穿透规则需要1.03-1.13倍于这些设置中真实规则的符号.

blocks.en: D.4 Transplanted weight changes
blocks.zh: D.4 移植重量变化

blocks.en: Table D3 gives the legal-move mass and the change in background loss for every change and recipient checkpoint. At 9.7M the Frobenius norm of the change due to the returned targets was 1.7% of that of the final weights for the 619M-token checkpoint and 11% for the 97M-token checkpoint; at 64M, relative to the weights of its own checkpoint, it was 0.8–0.9% at 1.93B tokens, 1.5% at 226M and 3.2–3.3% at 161M. Legal-move mass and background loss were evaluated on the 1,000 held-out games used for the returns.
blocks.zh: 表D3列出每次更改和接收检查站的法律移动质量和背景损失。 在9.7M时,Frobenius因返回目标而改变的标准是619M-托肯检查站最终重量的1.7%,97M-托肯检查站最终重量的11%;在64M时,相对于其本身检查站的重量,在1.93B令牌时为0.8-0.9%,在226M时为1.5%,在161M时为3.2-3.3%。 对用于回报的1 000个搁置游戏进行了质量和背景损失评价。

blocks.en: At 9.7M, across the checkpoints with a measured acquisition cost, nine in one seed and six in the other, the rank correlation between the recipient’s cost and the mass gained was − 0.85 -0.85 and − 0.49 -0.49 for the change from the 193M-token checkpoint. The weight change of a return without the subtraction of its control run raised legal-move mass at other checkpoints similarly but raised background loss by 0.16–0.26 nats for the changes from 619M, 290M and 193M tokens and by 0.32–0.44 for the change from 97M, as did the change of the control run alone; the cosine similarity between the two was 0.86–0.98. Changes computed at different checkpoints of a run had a cosine similarity of 0.06–0.23 with one another and of 0.00 between seeds. At 64M the Gaussian change gained between − 0.010 -0.010 and − 0.001 -0.001 and the change added to the other seed’s checkpoints between − 0.000 -0.000 and + 0.002 +0.002 in legal-move mass.

blocks.en: Appendix E Returns at 7 billion parameters and of whole domains
blocks.zh: 附录E 按70亿参数和整个域计算的收益

blocks.en: E.1 Returned targets at 7B
blocks.zh: E.1 联合国 返回目标为7B

blocks.en: Every 7B cost in this subsection and in Table E1 is relative to the matched fully supervised reference of the same seed. The six snapshots are at steps 2,048, 2,896, 4,096, 5,793, 8,192 and 12,817, and each is continued from the first data block that it has not trained on. The capital targets return with batches of 128 sequences of 2,048 tokens. The five-evaluation smoothing in logit is applied to the returns and to the reference alike.
blocks.zh: 本分节和表E1中每7B个成本与完全监督的同一种子的对应参考相对。 这6个快照位于第2,048,2,896,4,096,5,793,8,192和12,817步,每个快照都从它没有受过训练的第一个数据块继续. 首都目标回报 批次128个序列2,048个令牌. 记录中的五种评价平滑适用于返回和参考。

blocks.en: A sustained crossing requires three consecutive smoothed evaluations at or above the acquisition level. In seed 0 it gives the same cost as the first crossing of the smoothed curve for the returns from steps 12,817 and 8,192, and 22.6% against 15.2% from step 5,793; in seed 1 it gives the same cost at all three steps (Fig. E1c). In seed 0 the first evaluation at or above the level, without smoothing, comes at 0.8%, 3.0%, 14% and 35% for the last four checkpoints. With only the first answer token supervised, the true assignment reached the level after 1.9%, 10.8% and 40.7% of the reference’s tokens from steps 12,817, 8,192 and 4,096 of seed 0. In the 7B model with the capital targets permuted from initialization, the true assignment stayed at or below a competence of 0.08.
blocks.zh: 持续过境需要连续三次在购置水平或以上进行平稳评价。 在0号种子中,它为从12,817和8,192步返回的平滑曲线首次穿越提供了同样的成本,22.6%为从5,793步返回的15.2%;在1号种子中,它为所有三个步骤提供了同样的成本(图E1c)。 在0号种子中,在未平稳的情况下,对上四个检查站的首次评价为0.8%、3.0%、14%和35%。 仅监督第一个答复信使,真正的任务在1.9%、10.8%和40.7%的参考信使从12,817、8,192和4,096种子0. 在7B模式中,资本目标从初始化中渗透出来,实际任务保持在或低于0.08的权限。

blocks.en: Agreement targets, removed in the source model, were returned at the same six checkpoints with an acquisition level of 0.85, which model B reaches after 78.4M tokens in seed 0 and 74.3M in seed 1. The six returns reached it after 2.7–4.0% of the tokens of their seed’s model B in seed 0 and 2.7–5.6% in seed 1 (Fig. E1c,e). The source model continued from step 8,192 without returned targets did not reach the capital level (Fig. E1d), and background loss rose by at most 0.014 nats above its value at the return during a capital return of seed 0 (Fig. E1f).
blocks.zh: 在原产地模式中被删除的协议目标在同一6个检查站被退回,采购水平为0.85,在0号种子的78.4M令牌和1号种子的74.3M之后,B号模型达到78.4M令牌. 6个回转在种子0的种子标本B的2.7–4.0%和种子1的2.7–5.6%(图E1c,e)后到达. 来源模式从第8,192步继续发展,没有返回目标没有达到资本水平(图E1d),背景损失最多增加0.014纳特,在种子0(图E1f)返回资本时超过其价值。

blocks.en: E.2 Domains returned after filtering
blocks.zh: E.2 过滤后返回域

blocks.en: Term accuracy at 7B is read at every evaluation of the returned model and of the continued model B, 162 each. Both streams are unfiltered, so the ratio of tokens is also the ratio of Rust tokens. The filter had left about 259,000 reference-labelled Rust tokens in the 15,000 steps before the return, a realised share of 0.029 and the Rust content of 116.8M tokens of the unfiltered stream at its rate of 0.222%. With these counted, the Rust tokens of the filtered model when half, three quarters and nine tenths of the gap had closed are 28%, 13% and 18% of those model B had read at the same accuracy. Three quarters of the gap closed after 40M tokens against 1.20B from initialization and nine tenths after 341M against 2.59B. Over the same continuation the gap in Rust loss fell from 0.57 to 0.10 nats, and accuracy on astronomy and Chinese terms stayed within 0.01 of model B’s (Fig. E1i).
blocks.zh: 在每次评价返回的模型和继续使用的模型B时,都会读取7B的准确性,每个模型162。 两条溪流都是未过滤的,所以信使的比例也是Rust信使的比例. 过滤器在返回前的15,000个步骤中留下了大约259,000个带有参考标签的Rust令牌,实际份额为0.029,未过滤流的Rust令牌含量为116.8M,其比例为0.22%。 在计算了这些之后,当一半、四分之三和十分之九的空白已经关闭时,被过滤的模型的Rust标志是28%、13%和18%的模型B读得同样准确。 四分之三的空隙在40M令牌后与1.20B从初始化关闭,九分之三一M对2.59B关闭. 在同样的延续期间,Rust损失的差距从0.57纳特下降到0.10纳特,而天文学和中文术语的准确性保持在模型B的0.01(图E1i)。

blocks.en: Each sampled completion is cut at the brace that closes the function. At the return the filtered model passed the hidden assertions in 3.8% of completions (95% interval 2.5–5.1) and model B in 7.3% (5.0–9.9); after 500M tokens the values were 6.3% (4.5–8.2) and 7.6% (5.5–10.0) (Fig. E1h). The filtered model compiled 19.8%, 19.9%, 16.3%, 16.8%, 20.0%, 28.5% and 37.4% of its completions after 7.9M, 15.7M, 31.5M, 62.9M, 126M, 252M and 500M tokens. Model B continued on the same blocks compiled 44.7%, 43.6% and 41.1% and passed 7.3%, 7.5% and 7.6% at 0, 126M and 500M tokens.

At 20M–300M the other two domains of each model are filtered as in the Latin square. Shares use five-evaluation smoothing in logit and first interpolated crossings for the returned run and for the unfiltered run from initialization. Table E2 gives every share. The Chinese model at 300M had closed 42% of its gap after 5.9% of the tokens from initialization. The constant was also preferred to a form with a logit-distance term ( − 0.15 ± 0.38 -0.15\pm 0.38 per logit) and to one with domain intercepts; the AICc of the three other forms was 3.5–6.0 higher. Within 300 steps, one of the twelve returns closed three quarters of its gap; the others had closed 42–67%, and their shares exceed 3.8–13.2%.
blocks.zh: 在20M-300M时,每个模型的另外两个域像拉丁广场一样被过滤. 股份公司在登录时使用5个评价平滑,在返回的运行和未过滤的初始化运行时使用第一个插值交叉. 表E2列出每一份额。 300M的中国模式在初始化5.9%的代币后,已经关闭了42%的缺口. 常数还被选用一个有对数-距离术语的表(每对数为0.15±0.38-0.15\pm0.38)和一个有域截取功能的表;另外三种表的AICc更高3.5-6.0. 在300个步骤中,12个返回中有一个填补了四分之三的缺口;其他的关闭了42-67%,其份额超过3.8-13.2%。

blocks.en: F.1 Removal routes
blocks.zh: F.1 清除路线

blocks.en: Chess. The 13 cases are 9.7M, 24M, 64M (two seeds) and 163M models at two or three background losses each. Costs relative to initialization use the runs from initialization at 9.7M, 24M and 64M. No 163M model was trained from initialization on the schedule of the return runs, so the two 163M cases are divided by the tokens at which the fully supervised 163M training run of the same seed reaches the level (142.8M). At 9.7M–64M that training schedule reaches the level at 0.59–0.85 times the tokens of the run from initialization on the return schedule, so the 163M ratios are upper estimates relative to the other sizes.
blocks.zh: 国际象棋. 13例为9.7M型,24M型,64M型(两种子)和163M型,每型损失2-3个背景. 与初始化有关的费用使用从初始化到9.7M、24M和64M的费用。 没有163M型号在返程时刻表上从初始化开始训练,因此两款163M型机车被完全监督的163M型机车相同种子的训练达到水平(142.8M)的符号除以. 在9.7M-64M时,培训时间表达到0.59-0.85倍于返回时间表上初始化的标志,因此,163M比率是相对于其他尺寸的较高估计值。

blocks.en: Web text. The agreement targets are the six number-marked auxiliaries, and competence is the preference for the auxiliary over its number partner. For each of two seeds, one fully supervised model and one model without agreement targets are trained from initialization for 1.07B tokens; the cases are steps 1,448 and 4,096 of each seed, at background losses of 4.14–4.19 and 3.65–3.67 nats. The withdrawn route continues the fully supervised model from an earlier step without agreement targets until it has read the rows of the never-supervised model at the case step (111M or 315M tokens). Gradient ascent keeps the state of lowest competence whose background loss is at most 0.05 nats above the start. Ascent on the full cross-entropy at the agreement targets lowers the probability of every auxiliary and changes the choice between them little, whereas the two-way loss acts on the choice that competence scores (open and filled diamonds in Fig. F1i–k). Five unlearned models were at the acquisition level when the targets returned. At the return the background losses of the routes of a case lie within 0.04 nats. In the 30 warm-up steps the learning rate rises linearly to 2.12 × 10 − 3 2.12\times 10^{-3} , evaluations fall at steps 12% apart beyond step 40, and a return stops after four evaluations at or above 0.85 or at a budget of 700 steps (92M tokens) when all targets return and 1,000 steps (131M tokens) when 10% return; no return reached its budget. The fully supervised training runs reach the level after 119M and 133M tokens. Never-supervised models reached it with 1.8–2.6% of those tokens when all targets returned and with 2.3–2.6% when 10% returned.
blocks.zh: 网易网讯. 协议目标为6个编号的辅助人员,能力是辅助人员与其数字伙伴相比的偏好. 每两个种子,一个完全监督的模型和一个没有协议指标的模型从初始化开始接受1.07B令牌的培训;每个种子中1 448个步骤和4 096个步骤,背景损失为4.14-4.19和3.65-3.67纳特。 被撤销的路线从没有协议目标的较早的一步延续了完全监督的模型,直到它读懂了案件步骤(111M或315M令牌)中从未监督的模型的行. 逐步上升使能力最低的状态保持在起步点上0.05纳特。 协议目标完全交叉,降低了每个辅助设备的概率,并改变了它们之间的选择,而双向损失则取决于能力得分的选择(在F1i-k中打开和填充的钻石)。 目标返回时,有5个未学习模式处于购置阶段。 案件路线的背景损失在0.04纳特以内。 在30个加热步骤中,学习率线性上升至2.12×10−3 2.12\times 10−3},评价在40步之后相隔12%,在0.85或以上4个评价之后或在所有目标返回时700步(92M令牌)的预算之后,返回停止;在10%返回时,返回不到预算。 完全监督的培训在119M和133M令牌之后达到水平。 从未受到监督的模型在全部目标返回时达到了1.8-2.6%,在10%返回时达到了2.3-2.6%。

blocks.en: SMILES. Competence is the probability of the true closing digit on 8,000 held-out molecules. The withdrawn route continues the fully supervised model from 5 or 12 tokens per parameter without ring-closure targets to the training rows of the case. Gradient ascent uses the cross-entropy at ring-closure targets, which is the loss of the decision that competence scores. Gradient ascent stopped at the limit on background loss and misdirection at a plateau of competence. At the return the background losses of the routes of a case lie within 0.02 nats. Costs are relative to the tokens at which the fully supervised training run of the same size and seed reaches the acquisition level of 0.6. From the same starting competence, never-supervised models needed 5.6–7.9, 5.2–10.7 and 3.7–6.5 times the tokens of withdrawn, gradient-ascent and misdirection models ( n = 24 n=24 ). The removed models reach the level within one to three optimizer steps, so each ratio is resolved to about a factor of 1.5. With all targets returned, never-supervised models reached the level with 2.0–3.0% of the tokens of the training run. With 10% returned they reached it in 7 of 8 cases within the budget of 8M tokens, and all 24 other models reached it at 0.27–1.4%. Without ring-closure targets, models unlearned by misdirection fell to about 0.01 and stood at 0.01–0.09 after 240 further steps, withdrawn models moved by at most 0.05 and never-supervised models by at most 0.003 over the warm-up and the further steps (Fig. F1k).
blocks.zh: 尖叫声。 能力是8000个悬浮分子上真正关闭数字的概率. 撤走的路线将完全监督的模型从每个参数的5或12个令牌而不设环闭合目标延续到案件的训练排. 渐渐升起在环闭合目标上使用横切,即失去能力得分的决定. 渐渐上升止于背景损失的限度,并在能力高地误入歧途。 案件路线的背景损失在0.02纳特以内。 费用是相对于充分监督的相同规模和种子的培训达到0.6的购置水平。 从相同的初始能力来看,从未接受过监督的模型需要5.6–7.9,5.2–10.7和3.7–6.5倍于撤回、梯度上升和方向错误模型的标志(n=24n=24). 被移除的模型在1到3个优化步骤内达到水平,因此每个比例被解决到大约1.5倍. 随着所有目标返回,从未接受过监督的模型达到了培训的2.0-3.0%。 8个案件中有7个在8M令牌的预算中实现了10%的回报,其他24个模型都达到了0.27-1.4%。 在没有环闭目标的情况下,因错误方向而未吸取的模型在240个进一步步骤之后下降到0.01至0.09,被撤回的模型在最多0.05个步骤之后移动,在暖和和和进一步步骤之后从不监督的模型最多达到0.003个(图F1k)。

blocks.en: F.2 Earlier supervision
blocks.zh: F.2 早期监督

blocks.en: The reference includes two 9.7M models trained to 1.66 nats with targets returned from 26 checkpoints each, which cover the background loss of every model that kept 3%. The returns of a compared model are used only inside the reference’s range of background loss at its size. The variance between and within source runs of the reference is taken to be the same for the compared models, and the interval uses t t quantiles on the reference’s degrees of freedom.
blocks.zh: 参考材料包括两个9.7M型号,训练到1.66纳特,目标从26个检查站返回,涵盖了每个保持3%的型号的背景损失。 比较模型的返回只用于参考物大小的背景损失范围。 参考文献来源之间和内部的差异对于比较模型来说是相同的,间隔使用 t t 的四分位数来表示参考文献的自由度。

blocks.en: F.3 Related king-safety positions
blocks.zh: F.3 相关的国王安全立场

blocks.en: Inputs stay intact in every family-masking run, and background loss is measured on targets outside check and outside the masked families. The nine background losses are equally spaced. In the range over the 16 assignments of a seed to each fraction, each assignment is refitted with its own κ ⁡ ( L ) \kappa(L) and τ ⁡ ( L ) \tau(L) .
blocks.zh: 在每一次家庭装模作样的比赛中,投入都保持完好无损,背景损失是根据检查外和被蒙面家庭外的目标来衡量的。 9个背景损失的间距相同. 在16项种子分配到每个分数的幅度内,每次分配都用自己的 \\ (L)\ kappa(L) 和\ (L)\ tau(L) 来重排。

blocks.en: F.4 Restricted returns, representation edit and stitched models
blocks.zh: F.4 限制返回、代表编辑和缝合模型

blocks.en: Restricted returns. A trainable block comprises both norms, the attention and the MLP; every block is tested in one source run and the first, middle and last block in the other. Adapters W ​ x + B ​ A ​ x Wx+BAx are placed on all seven linear maps of every block, with A A uniform in ± d in − 1 / 2 \pm d_{\mathrm{in}}^{-1/2} and B = 0 B=0 at the start, and all other weights are held fixed. Trainable groups keep their learning rates, and adapters take the rate of the hidden matrices without weight decay. Where no multiplier gave a permuted return that reached the level, the multiplier with the highest final permuted mass was used; the unrestricted return uses the standard learning rate. The unrestricted returns cost 0.23–0.78% of the tokens from initialization and the permuted rule 12.0–16.6 times more. A single block in the upper half cost 4.1–7.0, 2.6–4.2 and 2.2–2.8 times the unrestricted return at 9.7M, 24M and 64M. The first block alone cost 39–50 times at 64M and did not reach the level at 9.7M and 24M, and the unembedding with the final norm cost 12–13 times at 64M and did not reach it at 9.7M and 24M. Adapters of rank 1, 4 and 16 cost 3.3–58, 2.2–7.4 and 1.3–3.1 times. Both rules reached 0.6 under 19 restrictions, only the true rule under 36 and neither under 9. The best multiplier lay at the top of the grid for rank-1 adapters, for rank-4 adapters at 64M and for the rank-16 adapter of one 64M run, so the adapter costs are upper estimates. The experiment comprises 396 runs.
blocks.zh: 限制返回。 一个可列车区块包括规范,注意力和MLP;每个区块在一个源运行中测试,另一个区块的第一个,中间和最后一个区块测试. 适配器 W x + B 每个区块的所有7个线性地图上都安放一个x Wx+BAx,在 − 1 / 2\pm d_{\mathrm{in}}^{1/2}和 B = 0 B = 0 开始时,A uniform in ± d in − 1 / 2\pm d_{\mathrm{in}}^{1/2},其他重量均固定. 训练有素的团体保持其学习率,适配器采用隐藏基质的速率而不减重. 在没有乘数给出达到水平的穿透返回时,使用最终穿透质量最高的乘数;无限制返回使用标准学习率. 不受限制的回报从初始化和被渗透的规则中花费了0.23–0.78%的代币,增加了12.0–16.6倍. 上半部分的单块成本为4.1至7.0、2.6至4.2和2.2至2.8倍于9.7M、24M和64M的无限制返回。 单是第一块块在64M就花费了39–50次,没有达到9.7M和24M的水平,而未与最终规范化的成本在64M就花费了12–13次,没有达到9.7M和24M的水平. 1,4和16级的适配器耗资3.3–58,2.2–7.4和1.3–3.1次. 这两项规则在19个限制下达到0.6个,只有36个限制下达到真正的规则,9个限制下达到真正的规则。 最佳乘数位于格子的顶端,用于等级1适配器,等级4适配器在64M,等级16适配器在1个64M运行,因此适配器成本为上估. 实验包括396次运行.

blocks.en: Representation edit. The three checkpoints of each source run are at 10, 20 and 64 tokens per parameter at 9.7M and at 5, 12 and 16 at 24M. The counterfactual position pairs come from the 30% of games held out from the fit of the subspace, and the edit replaces the subspace by its mean for the side to move. A checkpoint was used if the edit removed at least half of the readout, raised background loss by at most 0.20 nats and removed at least five times as much as random rank-8 ablations; all 24 checkpoints met these conditions.
blocks.zh: 代表编辑. 每个来源运行的三个检查站为10、20和64个令牌,每个参数为9.7M,24M为5、12和16。 反事实位置对来自从子空间适配状态中持有的30%的游戏,编辑时将子空间替换为侧移动的平均值. 如果编辑至少去除一半的读数,造成至少0.20纳特的背景损失,并去除至少5倍于随机排位8的弹片,则使用检查站;所有24个检查站都符合这些条件。

blocks.en: Stitched models. At 9.7M (8 blocks, two seeds) the late checkpoint is at 619M tokens and the early ones at 290M and 193M tokens, where the unrestricted return costs 3.2–3.6 and 7.9–8.4 times as much, with K = 4 K=4 in both seeds and K = 2 K=2 and 6 in one. At 64M (13 blocks, one seed) the checkpoints are at 644M and 161M tokens, a 6.7-fold difference in cost, with K = 3 K=3 , 6 and 10. Every stitched model continues on the data that follow the late checkpoint. The two data orders agreed within 23%, and every run reached 0.6. After the 30 warm-up steps the background loss of each stitched model lay within 0.01 nats of the range spanned by its two checkpoints. The intact models that define the line are three at 9.7M and two at 64M. At 9.7M the position of a stitched model between its two checkpoints followed the number of late blocks: 0.36–0.43, 0.55–0.60 and 0.70–0.87 of the range in log cost with six, four and two late blocks. At 64M late upper blocks lowered background loss, and with it the cost, more than late lower blocks (0.28 against 0.65 of the range at K = 6 K=6 ). The ratio of permuted to true cost followed the true-rule cost: 16.3 and 4.3 for the intact 64M checkpoints, 11.8 and 6.0 for the stitched models at K = 6 K=6 . The experiment comprises 96 runs.
blocks.zh: 脚踏样板 在9.7M(8块,2个种子)时,后期检查站为619M令牌,早期为290M令牌和193M令牌,其中无限制返回费用为3.2–3.6和7.9–8.4倍,种子均以K=4K=4,K=2K=2和6为1. 在64M(13个区块,1个种子)时,检查站为644M和161M令牌,成本差6.7倍,K=3K=3,6和10. 每一个缝合的模型都延续在后期检查站的数据上. 两项数据订单在23%范围内达成一致,每次运行达到0.6次. 在30个热身步骤之后,每个缝合模型的背景损失都在两个检查站所覆盖的0.01纳特范围内。 定义该线的完整模型有3个在9.7M,2个在64M. 在9.7M时,其两个检查站之间的缝合型号的位置紧随后面的后期区块数:0.36-0.43、0.55-0.60和0.70-0.87,其中6、4和2个后期区块。 在64M后期上层区块降低了背景损失,因此成本也降低了后期下层区块(0.28对0.65的幅度为K=6K=6). 实际成本与实际成本的比率遵循了真实规则成本:完整无缺的64M检查站为16.3和4.3,缝合型号为11.8和6.0K=6K=6。 试验共96次。

blocks.en: Appendix G Statistics
blocks.zh: 附录G

blocks.en: In the analyses of acquisition cost a point is one return run, and a source run is one training run at one seed, shared by its checkpoints. Least-squares rates for single domains are given with the larger of the ordinary and the cluster-robust standard error. Along a thinned trajectory, the offsets at interpolated background losses are repeated measurements of that trajectory, so errors of the derived relation are taken over models and held-out prediction errors are given per trajectory. Probabilities of output classes have intervals from 1,000 bootstrap resamples of games, and the isolated web-text contrasts have t t intervals over four seeds. The family-masking contrast has two paired seeds, so the range over the 16 recombinations of seeds is shown in place of a sampling interval.
blocks.zh: 在对购置成本的分析中,一个点是一次返回运行,一个源点是一次种子运行,由检查站共用。 单个域的最小平方速率的给出是普通和集群-robust标准错误中较大的. 沿着较薄的轨迹,内插背景损失的抵消是对该轨迹的反复测量,因此得出关系的误差被取而代之的是模型,并给出了每个轨迹的悬停预测误差. 输出类的概率从游戏的1000个靴子圈复刻图中产生间隔,孤立的网络文字对比则在4个种子上产生t的间隔. 家族-抹面对比有两对种子,因此在16个种子的重新组合上所显示的范围以代替采样间隔.
